(2015) 的解或无约束模型，会偏好错误解，即把东北方向（NE）恒星识别为源星；但作者利用 Keck 追观测给出的相对自行方向约束进行图像约束光变曲线模型拟合，**证明正确解应把 NE 星识别为透镜星**。无约束模型中的差异由 FTS 与 MOA B & C 数据的系统误差以及相对自行方向约束的影响共同驱动。该结果对未来 Roman 数据分析给出两点重要经验：(1) 需在所有滤光波段彻底检查系统误差，并确定 $\chi^2$ 差异的精确来源；(2) 应采用包含相对自行方向约束的图像约束光变曲线建模来识别正确的透镜。
summary: We present Keck/NIRC2 adaptive optics imaging results of planetary microlensing event OGLE-2012-BLG-0563. We find that the OGLE-2012-BLG-0563L planetary system consists of a 1.12 +/- 0.09 Jupiter-mass planet orbiting a 0.81 +/- 0.04 solar-mass host star at a distance of 5.49 +/- 0.56 kpc from the Sun. This event has a lens-source separation of 23.28 +/- 0.48 mas, which is the smallest lens-source separation measured to date with Keck AO data. We find that the incorrect solution - which identifies the Northeast (NE) star as the source star - is favored if one only considers the discovery paper, the Fukui et al. (2015) solution, or an unconstrained model. However, by performing an image-constrained light curve model fit using the relative proper motion direction constraint from the Keck follow-up data, we demonstrate that the correct solution identifies the NE star as the lens star. The discrepancy in the unconstrained models is driven by systematics in the FTS and MOA B & C data, alongside the impact of the relative proper motion direction constraints. This outcome offers two important lessons for future Roman data analysis: (1) thoroughly verify systematics across all passbands and identify the precise origin of chi-squared differences, and (2) utilize image-constrained light curve modeling incorporating relative proper motion direction constraints to identify the correct lens.

title: Optimal cosmological cross-correlation analysis with U-Net-based processing
background_knowledge: 宇宙学互相关分析通过比较两类宇宙场（例如密度场、星系分布或巡天示踪场与目标场）的统计关联来提取宇宙学信息。传统方法主要依赖两点统计，如功率谱与互功率谱；这些统计量对高斯随机场是最优的。然而，晚期宇宙中的密度场、星系分布等普遍具有非高斯性，两点统计无法捕获全部相关信息，因此需要高阶统计量或机器学习方法来挖掘超出功率谱的信息。U-Net 是一种编码器—解码器卷积神经网络，能够学习输入场到输出场的非线性变换；在互相关研究中，可利用成对模拟数据训练网络，使变换后的示踪场与目标场尽可能高度相关。
contribution: 论文将示踪场作为输入、配对目标场纳入代价函数，检验一维 U-Net 能否学习一个与目标场最大相关的变化后示踪场。作者在高斯与对数正态随机场的受控模拟上训练网络，使用与目标场的 Pearson 相关系数评估性能，并与高斯极限下的解析线性解比较。结果表明：对高斯场，U-Net 密切复现预期线性解，并在频率空间表现为有效匹配滤波；对对数正态场，网络偏离线性估计器，**将平均 Pearson 相关系数从线性估计器的 0.857 提高到 U-Net 输出的 0.953**，说明网络能够利用功率谱之外的信息。这些一维受控实验表明，基于 U-Net 的示踪场变换可有效提取与互相关分析有关、超出功率谱的信息，为增强宇宙学互相关分析提供了有前景的框架。
summary: Cosmological cross-correlation analyses are commonly based on two-point statistics, which are optimal for Gaussian random fields but do not capture all relevant information in the presence of non-Gaussianity, which is ubiquitous in late-time cosmic fields. This motivates investigations of higher order statistics, and one method is to use machine learning to construct a correlation-optimized tracer field that can utilize cross-correlation information beyond two-point statistics. Using a tracer field as input and a paired target field as part of the cost function, we test whether a U-Net can learn a transformed tracer field that maximally correlates with the target field. We train a 1D U-Net on paired simulated fields and study controlled cases based on Gaussian and log-normal random fields. We train and quantify performance using the Pearson correlation coefficient with the target field and compare the network output with the analytic linear solution known in the Gaussian limit. For Gaussian fields, the U-Net reproduces the expected linear solution closely and behaves as an effective matched filter in frequency space. For log-normal fields, the network departs from the linear estimator and achieves an improved correlation with the target field, increasing the mean Pearson correlation from 0.857 for the linear estimator to 0.953 for the U-Net output. This indicates that the network is sensitive to information beyond the power spectrum. These controlled 1D experiments show that U-Net-based tracer transformation can effectively extract correlation-relevant information beyond the power spectrum, providing a promising framework for enhancing cosmological cross-correlation analyses.

title: The THESAN-ZOOM project: the delayed rise of Lyman continuum escape fractions in bursty high-redshift galaxies
background_knowledge: 高红移星系是宇宙再电离时期的主要电离光子源之一。星系内部大质量恒星产生能量高于 13.6 eV 的莱曼连续谱（LyC）光子，但只有一部分能穿过星际介质、星系风与尘埃并逃逸到星系际介质，这一比例由逃逸分数 $f_{\mathrm{esc}}$ 描述。理解再电离的关键，不仅在于星系产生了多少电离光子，还在于光子产生与逃逸通道打开是否在时间上重合。该子领域通常结合星系形成理论、恒星形成与反馈、辐射转移和宇宙学模拟来研究：恒星形成爆发会加热并驱动气体外流，同时反馈也可能清空通道、提高气体透明度；当源星族衰减时，先前被吹开低密度通道可能仍存在，因此逃逸可能相对恒星形成活动出现延迟。观测上，LyC 直接探测在高红移受星系际介质吸收限制，研究者常借助 H$\alpha$、紫外光度、星系质量、恒星形成历史等示踪量间接约束逃逸。模拟研究则通过辐射流体力学与后处理辐射转移，在约百万年量级时间分辨率上考察星系输出随时间的演化，并用互相关、时滞和爆发历史分析连接光子产生率、气体透射率与逃逸分数。
contribution: 论文利用 THESAN-ZOOM 辐射流体力学模拟中 13 个 $z>3$ 的目标暗晕，以 COLT 辐射转移进行后处理，并按约 10 Myr 间隔采样，系统研究高红移爆发星系中 LyC 逃逸分数相对恒星形成活动的延迟关系。作者发现最清晰的延迟联系出现在 $\text{SFR}_{10}/\text{SFR}_{100}$ 与 LyC 逃逸分数之间：在取最近的正互相关峰时，**大质量暗晕中典型时滞约为 16 Myr，峰值相关系数为 0.4 到 0.6**，而质量较低时延迟更长且相干性更差。拟合得到的时滞大致随恒星质量和暗晕质量标度，分别约为 $M_\star^{-0.19}$ 与 $M_\text{halo}^{-0.27}$，但最短时滞已接近模拟快照的采样间隔。模拟中的重复变化跨越多个依赖于振幅的时间尺度，符合反复发生的恒星形成与反馈事件。近期恒星形成密切追踪本征电离光子产生率和逃逸光子率，而逃逸分数则反映气体透明度的演化。H$\alpha$ 与紫外光度之比与逃逸保持延迟关联，为观测上连接爆发阶段与 LyC 泄漏提供了可能途径；然而，**在星族衰减阶段即使气体透明度很高，也可能只有很少的逃逸辐射**。因此，**光子产生与气体透射在时间上的重叠共同决定了逃逸辐射的剂量与时机**，这对解释观测到的 LyC 泄漏星系及其对宇宙再电离的贡献具有重要意义。
summary: The ionizing radiation that galaxies release into their surroundings depends on whether efficient Lyman continuum (LyC) escape coincides with strong photon production. Stellar feedback can open escape paths as the source population fades, linking the escaping radiation to a galaxy's recent history. We investigate this timing in thirteen high-redshift (z > 3) target haloes from the THESAN-ZOOM radiation-hydrodynamic simulations, post-processed with COLT radiative transfer and sampled at ~10 Myr intervals. The clearest delayed relationship links $\text{SFR}_{10}/\text{SFR}_{100}$ to the LyC escape fraction. Selecting the nearest positive cross-correlation peak gives typical lags of ~16 Myr and peak correlations of 0.4-0.6 in massive haloes, with longer and less coherent delays towards lower masses. The fitted delays scale approximately as $M_\star^{-0.19}$ and $M_\text{halo}^{-0.27}$, although the shortest lags approach the native snapshot spacing. Recurrent variations span multiple amplitude-dependent timescales, consistent with repeated episodes of star formation and feedback. Recent star formation closely tracks both intrinsic and escaping photon rates, while the escape fraction reflects the evolving gas transparency. The H$α$-to-UV luminosity ratio retains a delayed association with escape, offering an observable connection between burst phase and leakage. High transparency during a fading phase can nevertheless yield little escaping radiation. The temporal overlap of photon production and transmission therefore shapes both the amount and timing of escaping radiation, informing the interpretation of observed leakers and their contribution to cosmic reionization.

title: A neural-network model to find correlations in astrochemical space
background_knowledge: 星际化学研究星际介质中分子的形成、演化与观测特征，核心对象包括冷暗分子云、原行星云及星形成区域。以金牛座分子云 TMC-1 为代表的冷暗云核心具有低温和高密度条件，气相离子—中性反应、尘埃表面反应与光化学过程共同决定分子丰度。观测上通常通过射电谱线证认分子，并借助辐射转移模型由谱线强度估计柱密度；柱密度又受元素丰度、分子结构、反应网络和云内物理条件影响。传统研究范式是“探测—证认—测量柱密度—与化学模型比较”，但近年来探测到的分子数量与种类快速增加，使数据驱动方法、分子表示学习和跨分子关联分析变得重要。自然语言处理中的字符串嵌入思想可用于把分子结构编码为连续向量，并在监督学习中连接分子结构与可观测丰度，为分布内预测和分布外物种推断提供新工具。
contribution: 论文构建了一套基于自然语言处理模型的机器学习流程，将编码分子结构的化学字符串与 TMC-1 中的分子柱密度联系起来，生成蕴含星际化学信息的嵌入，并用于后续监督学习任务。作者在神经网络框架中对该嵌入进行柱密度回归，覆盖原始分子清单与分布外物种；模型在训练加验证集与验证集上的均方误差 MSE 分别为 0.17/0.58，平均绝对误差 MAE 分别为 0.29/0.59，决定系数 $R^2$ 分别为 0.88/0.51。**模型学习到的潜在向量能够同时编码分子间的化学关系与分子的星际可探测性**。利用这些向量对 TMC-1 分子清单进行系统排列组合，作者识别出若干有希望在未来探测的候选体，以及大量非极性物种。通过用反映 TMC-1 不同历史探测阶段的分子数据集训练模型，作者发现 **近期分子探测以变革性而非渐进性的方式显著重塑了对星际化学的理解**。除准确预测分布内与分布外分子的柱密度趋势外，模型产生的潜在空间表示还为发展数据驱动的星际化学直觉与探索提供了基础。
summary: The detection of new interstellar molecules is central to astrochemistry, and arguably the most transformative development in the field in past decade has been the increase in both number and diversity of detected species. Using natural language processing models, we develop a machine-learning pipeline, similar to other approaches reported in the literature, to connect molecular structures, encoded as chemical strings, and molecular column densities in TMC-1. The workflow generates astrochemically informed embeddings that can be employed in subsequent supervised learning tasks. These representations are used within a neural-network framework to perform column-density regression on both the original molecular inventory and out-of-distribution species. The resulting model achieves mean squared error values of 0.17/0.58 and mean absolute error values of 0.29/0.59, and coefficients of determination of 0.88/0.51 for the train+validation and validation datasets. The latent vectors learned by the model are rich mathematical objects that capture the underlying chemical relations and also the potential interstellar detectability of the molecule. Using these vectors in molecules obtained from systematic permutations of the TMC-1 inventory, we identify several promising candidates for future detection in this cloud, together with a large number of apolar species. By training the model on datasets reflecting different historical epochs of molecular detections in TMC-1, we show that recent molecular detections have substantially reshaped our understanding of interstellar chemistry, in a transformative, rather than incremental, way. Beyond accurate prediction of column-density trends for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution molecules, the latent-space representations produced by the model provide a stepping stone for developing new forms of data-driven astrochemical intuition and exploration.

title: Discovering supernovae in the Virgo Cluster during the LSST era
background_knowledge:
时域天文学通过重复的宽视场成像来寻找光度快速变化的暂现源。超新星是恒星演化终点或白矮星热核爆炸产生的爆发现象，可分为热核型 Ia 超新星与核心坍缩型超新星等。它们既是研究恒星死亡、元素合成和星系化学演化的关键探针，也被广泛用于宇宙距离测量。星系团包含大量早型星系、部分旋涡星系以及热气体和暗物质，是研究超新星发现率随星系类型、恒星形成活动和环境变化的理想实验室。
\nVirgo 星系团是离银河系最近的富星系团之一，距离约 $D \simeq 16.5\ \mathrm{Mpc}$。在这一距离上，现代宽视场巡天可以在爆炸后很短时间内发现较暗的超新星，并触发后续测光与光谱观测。Legacy Survey of Space and Time（LSST）将由 Vera Rubin Observatory 执行，预计具有空前宽广、深邃且高 cadence 的成像能力，从而大幅提高近邻星系团中极年轻超新星的发现数。Shadow-LSST 等先导计划则可在 LSST 全面运行前检验发现与后随流程。
contribution: 论文以 Virgo 星系团（$D \simeq 16.5\ \mathrm{Mpc}$）为重点，估计在 LSST 提议的约 10 年寿命内，在不同星系团子结构和不同星系类型中预期可发现的极年轻超新星数量。**该工作为 LSST 时代 Virgo 星系团内极年轻超新星的发现率提供了预期估计**，并指出这些预测将在未来数年由 University of Arizona 领导的 Shadow-LSST 发现与后随计划进行观测检验。**论文强调，宽场、深巡天与高 cadence 的结合将显著提升在爆炸后数小时内发现近邻星系团超新星的机会**。
summary: In the era of unprecedentedly wide, deep and high-cadence sky surveys the chance for discovering new explosive transients in nearby, rich galaxy clusters within hours after explosion is expected to increase dramatically. In this paper we focus on the Virgo cluster ($D \simeq 16.5$ Mpc), and estimate the expected numbers of new, very young supernovae in different sub-structures and galaxy types of the cluster during the proposed lifetime (~10 years) of the Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) by the Vera Rubin Observatory. These predictions will be tested observationally during the ongoing Shadow-LSST discovery and follow-up program led by University of Arizona in the upcoming years.

title: The ALMA-QUARKS survey: A Keplerian Circumbinary Disk Candidate in the High-mass Star-forming Region IRAS 08303-4303
background_knowledge: 大质量恒星形成于分子云的致密核中，过程短暂、深埋于尘埃包层，并伴随强烈的吸积、外流与辐射反馈，因此观测难度较高。理解大质量恒星如何形成，尤其是双星和多星系统如何组装，是恒星形成研究的核心问题之一。大质量恒星中双星比例很高，环双星盘可在双星形成过程中输运物质、调节角动量，并可能通过引力不稳定性发生碎裂。毫米波和亚毫米波干涉观测，特别是 ALMA 的尘埃连续谱与分子谱线成像，能够分辨致密凝聚、吸积盘和外流，并利用分子气体的开普勒旋转进行动力学质量测量；Toomre $Q$ 参数则常用于判断盘的整体或局部引力稳定性。
contribution: 本文利用 ALMA Band 6 对高-mass 恒星形成区 IRAS 08303-4303 进行连续谱与分子谱线观测，角分辨率约为 $\sim 0.3''$（在 $2.35$ kpc 距离处约 $700$ au）。在 $1.3$ mm 连续谱中识别出 6 个致密凝聚，其中至少 4 个与分子外流相关联；估计的外流参数，尤其是质量外流率 $\geq 10^{-4}\ M_{\odot}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$，表明其驱动源为大质量年轻恒星体。两个凝聚组成间距约 $900$ au 的宽原双星系统，并共同位于一个质量约 $2\ M_{\odot}$ 的单一旋转结构中，该结构被认定为环双星盘候选体。多条分子线示踪这一结构并显示开普勒旋转；基于开普勒旋转假设，得到包围质量为 $32$–$61\ M_{\odot}$，其中主星为 $22$–$43\ M_{\odot}$，次星为 $10$–$18\ M_{\odot}$。该环双星盘整体上引力稳定，但部分区域 $Q < 2$ 暗示可能存在碎裂。多条分子线还揭示出连接环双星盘的 streamer-like 结构，提示物质可由包层经该结构转移至原双星系统。**尽管大质量年轻恒星体周围的环双星盘观测十分罕见，但大质量恒星的高双星比例凸显了其重要性；该源因此成为理解大质量双星系统形成的关键实验室。**
summary: We present the ALMA Band 6 continuum and molecular line observations of IRAS 08303-4303, a high-mass star-forming region, with an angular resolution of $\sim 0.3''$ ($\sim 700$ au at the distance of 2.35 kpc). Six dense condensations are identified in the 1.3 mm continuum, and at least four of them are associated with molecular outflows. The estimated outflow parameters, particularly mass outflow rates $\geq 10^{-4}$ $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$, suggest that the driving sources are high-mass young stellar objects. Two of the condensations are forming a wide protobinary system with a separation of $\sim 900$ au. They reside within a single rotating structure, identified as a circumbinary disk which has a mass of about 2 $M_{\odot}$. This structure is traced by multiple molecular lines and exhibits a Keplerian rotation pattern. Based on the Keplerian rotation assumption, the enclosed mass is derived to be between 32 and 61 $M_{\odot}$: 22-43 $M_{\odot}$ for the primary and 10-18 $M_{\odot}$ for the secondary. The circumbinary disk is on the whole gravitationally stable, yet some parts with Toomre $Q < 2$ indicate potential fragmentation. Various molecular lines reveal a streamer-like structure connecting to the circumbinary disk, suggesting transfer of material from the envelope to the protobinary system through it. Despite the observational rarity of such circumbinary disks around high-mass YSOs, the high binary fraction among massive stars underscores their significance. This source, therefore, serves as a key laboratory for understanding the formation of high-mass binary systems.

title: Decoherence of the quantum superradiant cloud from graviton emission
background_knowledge: 该方向位于黑洞物理、量子光学与量子引力的交叉处。旋转黑洞的能层可引发玻色场的超辐射不稳定性：场的真空涨落被不断放大，最终形成围绕黑洞的宏观玻色子云。对于超轻玻色子，这种云可以存活很长时间，因而被视为检验新粒子、引力理论以及宏观量子现象的天体物理平台。从量子光学看，超辐射云并非简单的经典场，而可处于具有量子关联的双模压缩态；当占据数很大时，其部分自由度又可用经典统计系综近似描述。与此同时，引力子发射等环境耦合会携带信息并导致退相干，使量子叠加或干涉逐渐不可观测，这是理解宏观量子系统如何呈现经典行为的关键。
contribution: 论文研究引力子发射如何改变旋转黑洞周围超辐射玻色子云的量子态。作者指出，在自由演化下该云为双模压缩态，即使占据数很大仍保持纠缠，而其增长分量可由经典统计描述。进一步发现，引力子发射会压低不同振幅的云构型之间的干涉，但对仅相差整体符号的构型之间的干涉没有影响；对于真空涨落产生的典型构型，当预期发射的引力子数达到 $ \mathcal{O}(1) $ 时，这种压低变得显著。作者还证明，在更大占据数下，云的所有一阶与二阶矩都可由相干态的统计混合重现。对于天体物理黑洞，上述两类变化均远早于黑洞自旋显著减慢发生，**表明引力子发射可在黑洞自旋明显演化之前使超辐射云失去部分量子相干性，并使其低阶统计性质趋于经典系综描述**。
summary: Black hole superradiance amplifies vacuum fluctuations into a macroscopic cloud of a massive bosonic field around a rotating black hole. Under free evolution, the quantum cloud is a two-mode squeezed state that remains entangled even at large occupation numbers, while its growing component admits a classical statistical description. In this work, we study how graviton emission changes the quantum state of the cloud. We find that graviton emission suppresses interference between cloud configurations with different amplitudes, but leaves interference between configurations that differ only by an overall sign unchanged. For typical configurations realized under vacuum fluctuations, the suppression becomes significant when the expected number of emitted gravitons is of order unity.We also show that, at larger occupation numbers, all first and second moments can be reproduced by a statistical mixture of coherent states. For the astrophysical black holes, both changes occur much before the spin-down of the black hole becomes significant.

title: EP J062132.0+623837: A Multi-wavelength Study of a Changing-look Active Galactic Nucleus Discovered by Einstein Probe
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（active galactic nucleus，AGN）由星系中心超大质量黑洞吸积物质供能，其多波段辐射覆盖射电、红外、光学、紫外和 X 射线。按统一模型，中心引擎与不同视角下的尘埃环、宽线区和窄线区共同塑造观测特征；光学谱中的宽 Balmer 线通常来自高速运动的宽线区气体，而 X 射线则直接追踪黑洞附近的日冕或吸积流。变化视向 AGN（changing-look AGN，CL AGN）指谱型在数年至数十年尺度上发生显著转变的 AGN，可能源于吸积率变化或遮蔽结构变化。传统上这类源多由重复光学光谱发现，宽场、时域 X 射线巡天则提供了从高能辐射侧系统搜寻并监测其剧烈变化的独立途径。
contribution: 论文利用 Einstein Probe（EP）宽场 X 射线望远镜（WXT）的 14 天分箱巡天数据发现新 X 射线源 EP J062132.0+623837，并通过 EP 后续 X 射线望远镜（FXT）将其定位到红移 $z=0.084$ 的星系 2MASX J06213207+6238390 中心。FXT 与 Swift/XRT 后续观测显示该源保持 X 射线活跃，观测光度约为 $(3-9)\times10^{43}\ \mathrm{erg\ s^{-1}}$，X 射线谱可由光子指数 $\Gamma\sim1.5$ 的幂律模型很好描述。宿主星系光学谱明确显示宽线 AGN，且其宽 Balmer 发射线较四年前的存档谱显著增强，从而标志从 Type 1.8 到 Type 1.5 的变化视向转变。长期光学与中红外光变曲线进一步表明，核区约在 2010 年发生剧烈增亮，此后持续呈现显著光变。综合空间符合与多波段行为，作者将 EP J062132.0+623837 认证为变化视向 AGN，**并展示宽场时域 X 射线巡天在发现变化视向 AGN 方面的巨大潜力，为系统证认这类源开辟了补充现有光学巡天的新途径**。
summary: EP J062132.0+623837 is a new X-ray source identified in 14-day binned survey data from the Wide-field X-ray Telescope aboard the Einstein Probe (EP). Subsequent X-ray observations with the Follow-up X-ray Telescope (FXT) on board EP localized the source to the central region of the galaxy 2MASX J06213207+6238390 at $z=0.084$. Here, we present a comprehensive analysis of the multi-wavelength data for this object. During the FXT and Swift/XRT follow-up, the source remained X-ray active, with observed luminosities of $(3-9)\times10^{43}$ erg s$^{-1}$, and its X-ray spectra were well described by power-law models with photon indices of $Γ\sim1.5$. The optical spectrum of the host galaxy clearly reveals a broad-line active galactic nucleus (AGN) exhibiting significantly enhanced broad Balmer emission lines compared to an archival spectrum obtained four years earlier, thereby marking a changing-look transition from Type 1.8 to Type 1.5. Furthermore, long-term optical and mid-infrared light curves indicate that the nucleus underwent dramatic brightening around 2010 and has since shown substantial variability. Given the spatial coincidence and multi-wavelength behavior, we identify EP J062132.0+623837 as a changing-look AGN, initially detected by EP and subsequently confirmed to exhibit large-amplitude variability across multiple bands. This case study demonstrates the great potential of wide-field time-domain X-ray surveys for discovering changing-look AGNs, paving a new avenue for their systematic identification as a powerful complement to ongoing optical surveys.

title: From Venus to the Parking Lot: A Flexible Stellar Interferometry Experiment
background_knowledge: 恒星干涉测量是突破单口径望远镜衍射极限、直接测定恒星角直径的重要方法。其物理基础是光场的空间相干性：来自遥远天体的光可近似为平面波，当用相距为 $B$ 的两个小孔（基线）采样波前时，两束光在焦面叠加形成干涉条纹。对于角直径约为 $\theta$ 的扩展光源，不同部位发出的光会形成彼此错位的条纹，使总条纹反衬度（可见度）随基线 $B$ 增大而下降；通过测量可见度随基线的变化，并利用 van Cittert–Zernike 定理及近似关系 $\theta \sim \lambda/B$（其中 $\lambda$ 为波长），可以反推光源的角直径。历史上，Michelson 恒星干涉仪正是利用这一原理首次测得参宿四等恒星的角直径。该实验的教学难点在于：真实天体干涉观测通常受行星/恒星可见性、大气视宁度、望远镜跟踪和暗夜条件限制，且学生难以用独立方法核验所测角直径。
contribution: 论文提出一种对既有“金星干涉测量演示”的简单扩展，使实验可在室内或室外进行，**不再依赖行星可见性或大气视宁度**。具体做法是把小手电筒置于望远镜前方 15 至 50 m 处，并用直径 2 至 6 mm 的圆孔掩模覆盖，作为人工扩展光源；望远镜前加不透明掩模，其上开两个直径 2 mm 的小孔，孔距可在 5 至 20 mm 间变化，用以观测该人工扩展光源产生的干涉条纹。学生通过改变孔距并观察条纹变化，可估计光源的角直径，并可利用简单几何关系直接核验结果——**这是使用真实天文目标时难以实现的定量检验**。该实验无需望远镜跟踪、无需暗夜，也不需原论文所述材料之外的特殊设备，可作为观测金星前的预实验、独立的室内日间或室外夜间活动，或作为对干涉测量方法本身的定量测试。
summary: We describe a simple extension of our earlier Venus interferometry demonstration that can be performed indoors or outdoors, independent of planetary visibility or atmospheric seeing. A small flashlight is placed 15-50 meters away from a telescope and covered with a circular aperture mask (hole diameter 2-6~mm). A small telescope fitted with an opaque mask bearing two 2~mm holes, spaced between 5 and 20~mm apart, is then used to observe interference fringes from this artificial extended source. By varying the hole separation and observing the fringes students can estimate the angular diameter of the source and verify their result directly by simple geometry, a check not possible with astronomical targets. The experiment requires no telescope tracking, no dark skies, and no special equipment beyond materials described in the original paper. It serves equally well as a pre-lab to build intuition before observing Venus, a standalone indoor daytime or outdoor nighttime activity, or a quantitative test of the interferometric method itself.

title: Multi-orbit S-star probes of Lorentz violation at the Galactic Center
background_knowledge: 洛伦兹不变性是粒子物理标准模型与广义相对论的基本假设之一，但量子引力等新物理可能在其高能尺度上引入微小偏离。标准模型扩展（SME）提供了一种系统、有效的场论框架，用一组系数参数化可能的洛伦兹破坏；在纯引力扇区，这些系数会改变引力两体动力学，产生随轨道方向变化、类似“优先参考系”的效应，从而可通过高精度天体轨道检验。银河系中心围绕 Sgr A* 运动的 S 星是强引力场检验的独特实验室：GRAVITY 等设备可测量其天体测量位置与视向速度，进而重建轨道并检验广义相对论预言的近星点进动等效应。然而，洛伦兹破坏参数在轨道上的投影依赖于轨道取向，不同参数之间容易产生几何简并；利用多条取向不同的 S 星轨道联合拟合，是打破简并、提取 SME 系数张量结构的关键策略。
contribution: 论文针对最小纯引力标准模型扩展（SME），评估银河系中心 S 星观测对洛伦兹破坏的探测能力，重点分析各向异性轨道信号导致的参数简并。作者基于 GRAVITY 合作组的多星解设定基准轨道与银心参数，构建 S2 与 S55 的模拟天体测量和光谱观测，并采用领头洛伦兹破坏两体动力学并加入 Schwarzschild 一阶后牛顿（1PN）修正来演化恒星轨迹。分别对 S2 和 S55 做 Fisher 矩阵分析时，各自可分辨八个独立 SME 方向中的七个；**联合分析则利用两条不同取向轨道的互补投影，分辨全部八个方向**。随后马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）分析证实了 Fisher 预报，并给出约 $10^{-3}$ 至 $10^{-2}$（时间-空间分量）以及 $10^{-5}$ 至 $10^{-4}$（空间分量）的 95% 可信水平特征灵敏度。**结果表明，将不同轨道取向的 S 星联合使用，可有效打破几何简并，并探测银河系中心引力场中洛伦兹破坏的张量结构。**
summary: We investigate the potential of Galactic-center S-star observations to probe Lorentz violation in the minimal pure-gravity Standard-Model Extension (SME), focusing on parameter degeneracies associated with anisotropic orbital signatures. We construct simulated astrometric and spectroscopic observations of S2 and S55 using fiducial orbital and Galactic-center parameters based on the multi-star solution from the GRAVITY Collaboration and evolve the stellar trajectories using the leading Lorentz-violating two-body dynamics supplemented by the Schwarzschild first-post-Newtonian (1PN) correction. Separate Fisher-matrix analyses of S2 and S55 each resolve seven of the eight independent SME directions, while their joint analysis resolves all eight directions by combining complementary projections from the differently oriented orbits. A subsequent Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) analysis confirms the Fisher forecasts and reaches characteristic 95% credible-level sensitivities of approximately 10^(-3)-10^(-2) for the time-space components and 10^(-5)-10^(-4) for the spatial components. Our results demonstrate that combining S-stars with different orbital orientations is effective for breaking geometrical degeneracies and probing the tensor structure of Lorentz violation in the Galactic-center gravitational field.

title: The first selection of optimal targets for the Lazuli ExtraSolar Coronagraph's reflected starlight exoplanet campaign
background_knowledge: 系外行星直接成像与高对比度日冕仪观测属于系外行星天文学中的大气表征方向：核心难点是从中心恒星的强光中分离出行星微弱的反射光或热辐射。日冕仪通过遮挡、波前控制与图像处理抑制星光，使在较小角距离处探测行星成为可能；可见光反射光观测的对比度需求可达 $10^{-9}$ 至 $10^{-10}$ 量级。与热红外成像相比，反射光通量主要取决于行星反照率与轨道几何，而不像热辐射那样强烈依赖年龄和内部热演化，因此可用于研究较成熟、较冷且更靠近恒星的巨行星，并为大气成分、云层和潜在生物标志物探测提供途径。地面与空间高对比度成像平台、径向速度与天体测量定轨的结合，是当前发现、确认并表征这类行星的主要范式。
contribution: 论文给出 Lazuli 空间望远镜（3 m）搭载的 ExtraSolar Coronagraph（ESC）开展可见光反射光系外行星观测的首批目标清单，共包含 **27 颗已知巨行星**。该清单覆盖此前直接成像尚未探测过的行星年龄与温度范围，其中部分目标也将可由 Nancy Grace Roman 空间望远镜的 Coronagraph Instrument 与 ELT-METIS 热红外成像仪观测，从而形成**综合大气表征与协同观测**。论文进一步讨论了 ESC 对这些目标开展观测所能实现的科学目标，以及未来天体测量与径向速度测量对目标选择和表征能力的提升。
summary: Direct detection and characterization of exoplanet atmospheres via reflected starlight enables probes of composition of mature exoplanet systems (since flux is decoupled from age) at closer separations than via thermal emission (due to observations in visible wavelengths), and even probes of biosignatures. New and upcoming ground and space-based platforms are enabling these observations for the first time. Recently the 3-m Lazuli Space Telescope, from the Eric and Wendy Schmidt Observatory System, was announced, which will be equipped with the ExtraSolar Coronagraph (ESC) designed for reflected light gas giant exoplanet observations in visible wavelengths. In this paper we present 27 known giant exoplanets that make up the first target list for these observations. Our target list spans ages and temperatures of planets not probed before by direct imaging, but some of which will also be accessible to the \textsl{Nancy Grace Roman} Coronagraph instrument and the ELT-METIS thermal imager, providing comprehensive atmosphere characterization and synergies. We discuss the science enabled by ESC observations of our target list and enhancements provided by future astrometric and radial velocity measurements.

title: Sound-Horizon-Agnostic Forecast for Constraints on $H_0$ and $Σm_ν$ from BAO, CMB Lensing, Supernovae and LSST-like Galaxy Lensing
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以 ΛCDM 模型为基准，用少数参数描述膨胀历史、物质与能量的组成以及初始扰动的统计性质。哈勃常数 $H_0$ 设定当前膨胀速率，重子拖曳时期的声视界 $r_d$ 则把早期宇宙的声学振荡标定为宇宙尺度的“标准尺”：BAO 测量星系分布中的优先分离尺度，CMB 的温度与偏振各向异性及透镜效应探测复合时期和后续结构增长，Ia 型超新星提供相对距离，星系弱引力透镜则同时敏感于几何、结构增长和物质分布。中微子质量会抑制小尺度结构增长，因而可通过透镜和宇宙大尺度结构限制 $\Sigma m_\nu$。当前 $H_0$ 的早期宇宙推断与近邻距离阶梯测量之间存在张力，而传统 BAO/CMB 联合分析通常依赖早期宇宙物理对 $r_d$ 的标定；把 $r_d$ 设为自由参数可检验 ΛCDM 的自洽性，但其解释仍取决于复合历史、早期暗能量等早期宇宙假设。
contribution:
论文提出并评估一个不依赖声视界标定的预测框架：将 $r_d$ 作为自由参数，联合 LSST 类星系弱引力透镜、Simons Observatory 类 CMB 透镜、完成的 DESI BAO 计划和扩展的超新星样本，同时把 CMB 透镜分析扩展到 $L_{\max}=5000$，并显式边缘化光度红移标定、乘性剪切偏差、内禀排列和重子反馈等星系弱透镜系统误差。在固定 $\Sigma m_
u$ 时，论文预测 **$\sigma(H_0)\simeq 1.5$ km/s/Mpc（最少信息先验）**、**$\sigma(H_0)\simeq 1.3$ km/s/Mpc（更严格先验）**，以及在加入原初涨落振幅 $A_s$ 信息先验后 **$\sigma(H_0)\simeq 0.7$ km/s/Mpc**；若允许 $\Sigma m_
u$ 自由变化，$H_0$ 约束会变弱，但仍可给出 **$\Sigma m_
u$ 的 95% CL 上限约 $0.4\ \mathrm{eV}$**。作者还用修改复合历史和早期暗能量模型的模拟数据检验该 $r_d$-agnostic 方法：对前者可无偏恢复 $H_0$，对后者则不能，说明其有效性依赖于对早期宇宙物理的假设。
summary: We present a sound-horizon-agnostic forecast for constraints on the Hubble constant $H_0$ and the sum of the neutrino masses $Σm_ν$ from a combination of LSST-like galaxy weak lensing, Simons-Observatory-like CMB lensing, the completed DESI BAO program, and expanded supernova samples. Treating the sound horizon at baryon drag $r_d$ as a free parameter, the method provides a consistency test of $Λ$CDM without relying on the standard early-Universe calibration of $r_d$. The analysis incorporates realistic galaxy weak-lensing systematics, explicitly marginalizing over photometric-redshift calibration, multiplicative shear biases, intrinsic alignments, and baryonic feedback, and extends the CMB-lensing analysis to $L_{\max}=5000$. For fixed $Σm_ν$, we forecast uncertainties of $σ(H_0)\simeq 1.5$ km/s/Mpc with our least informative prior set, $σ(H_0)\simeq 1.3$ km/s/Mpc with more restrictive priors, and $σ(H_0)\simeq 0.7$ km/s/Mpc with an additional informative prior on the amplitude of primordial fluctuations $A_s$. Allowing $Σm_ν$ to vary weakens the $H_0$ constraints, while still yielding a forecast 95% CL upper limit of about 0.4 eV on $Σm_ν$. We also clarify the scope of the $r_d$-agnostic approach through validation tests using mock data from modified recombination and early dark energy models. The method recovers unbiased constraints on $H_0$ for the former but not the latter, highlighting its dependence on assumptions about early-Universe physics.

title: A recurring changing state AGN discovered in the SAMI Galaxy Survey and SDSS
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积驱动，其辐射覆盖射电、光学、紫外、X 射线与伽马射线等多个波段。经典统一模型用观测视角、尘埃环和宽线区（BLR）的遮挡来解释 type 1 与 type 2 AGN 的差异：type 1 可直接看到宽发射线，type 2 的宽线被遮挡，而 1.8/1.9 型是中间状态。Changing-look AGN 指宽发射线在数月至数年尺度上出现或消失的天体，这一时标远短于传统吸积盘黏滞时标，因而对统一模型和吸积物理提出挑战。区分“尘埃遮蔽变化”与“内禀物理状态变化”是关键：多历元光谱可追踪宽线通量与线宽，WISE 中红外测光可示踪 AGN 尘埃辐射，光学光谱还需考虑宿主星系对 AGN 连续谱和宽线的稀释。宽线区内部可能存在不同运动学或空间成分，其响应变化也会改变宽线轮廓。
contribution: 作者结合 SDSS 与 SAMI Galaxy Survey 的多历元光谱以及 WISE 测光，详细分析了星系 J085337.26+014303.6 中红移 $z = 0.0582$ 处的 AGN。该源至少经历了一个完整的 changing-look AGN 循环：2001 年为 type 1.9，2015 年和 2021 年为 type 1，2022 年又回到 type 1.9；WISE 光变曲线还暗示其在 2020 年可能短暂返回 type 1.9。尽管宽线存在尘埃遮蔽的迹象，详细光谱分析与 WISE 测光表明这些变化源于**内禀物理状态改变，而非遮蔽变化**。光学波段由宿主星系主导：即使在高态，中心孔径内 4000 Å 处 AGN 的贡献也仅约 10%；而在最亮的 WISE W2 波段测量中，AGN 光度可与整个宿主星系相当。宽 Balmer 线呈现多成分结构：低态 type 1.9 中可见弱的极宽成分（${\rm FWHM} = 5000$--$6000\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$），高态 type 1 则由较强的宽成分（${\rm FWHM} \sim 2000\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$）主导；作者提出这由**宽线区内两个空间上不同的区域**造成。
summary: We present a detailed analysis of the AGN in galaxy J085337.26+014303.6 at z=0.0582. A combination of SDSS and SAMI Galaxy Survey data shows that this object has gone through at least one full changing-look AGN cycle, from type 1.9 in 2001 to type 1 in 2015 and 2021, and then type 1.9 again in 2022. While the broad lines in this object show evidence of dust obscuration, detailed spectral analysis plus WISE photometry demonstrate that the changes in this object are related to a physical state change, not changing obscuration. In fact, the WISE light curve suggests that this object may have briefly returned to a type 1.9 state in 2020. In the optical, the host galaxy dominates the light (e.g. only ~10 per cent contribution from the AGN at 4000 Angstoms within a central aperture), even in the high state. In contrast, the brightest WISE W2-band measurements place the AGN at a similar luminosity to the entire host galaxy. The broad Balmer lines show evidence of multiple components, with a weak very-broad component (FWHM=5000-6000 km/s) visible in the low type 1.9 state, and a stronger broad component of FWHM~2000 km/s dominating in the high type 1 state. We propose that this is caused by two spatially distinct regions within the broad line region.

title: The PAU Survey: Active galactic nucleus galaxies in galaxy pairs
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）是超大质量黑洞吸积物质并释放巨大能量的现象，其活动水平受气体供给、黑洞吸积效率、反馈过程以及星系所处环境共同调控。星系并合或近距离相遇可通过引力转矩改变气体角动量，驱动气体向核区流入，从而可能触发星暴和 AGN 活动；但相互作用也可能先造成尘埃遮蔽、形态扰动和恒星形成增强，使观测信号依赖波段与演化阶段。观测上常用近距离星系对作为相互作用阶段的统计探针，并用投影分离 $r_p$、视向速度差 $\Delta V$ 描述相互作用强度与动力学阶段。研究 AGN 与相互作用的联系需要大样本、可靠红移、多波段 AGN 选择以及匹配恒星质量（或绝对星等）、红移和环境的控制样本，以区分相互作用效应与星系本身性质和环境效应。PAUS 的高精度测光红移使这类统计研究可扩展到 $z \sim 1$ 的中等红移宇宙。
contribution: 论文利用 PAUS 的高精度测光红移，在 $z \sim 1.0$ 以内研究 AGN 与星系对之间的联系。样本包含 16,824 个投影分离 $r_p < 100$ kpc、视向速度差 $\Delta V < 3500$ km s$^{-1}$ 的星系对；将 PAUS 星系与多波段 AGN 星表交叉匹配，在 PAUS 的 8,880 个 AGN 中得到 270 个位于星系对中的 AGN。作者构建了孤立 AGN、成对非 AGN，以及按红移、绝对星等和环境匹配的孤立非 AGN 控制样本。结果显示，**星系对中的 AGN 随红移升高呈现逐渐变红的静止系颜色，尤其在 $z \gtrsim 0.5$ 时更明显**；相比之下，孤立 AGN 与成对非 AGN 没有显著颜色演化，颜色维持在 $M_g-M_r \sim 0.65$。此外，**含 AGN 的星系对更倾向于形态受扰动的相互作用系统，并出现在更小的投影分离和速度差处**，与动力学演化更充分的相互作用相符。作者据此认为，这些结果提供了**星系相互作用与 AGN 活动之间存在随红移变化的联系**的证据，提示**相互作用在中等红移对触发核区活动的作用增强**，并凸显 PAUS 在超越本地宇宙、以大统计威力研究 AGN-星系相互作用联系方面的独特能力。
summary: Aims. Leveraging the high-precision photometric redshifts of the Physics of the Accelerating Universe Survey (PAUS), we aim to investigate the connection between active galactic nuclei (AGNs) and galaxy pairs up to redshifts of $\sim1.0$. Methods. We identified 16,824 galaxy pairs with projected separations of $r_p < 100$ kpc and radial-velocity differences of $ΔV < 3500$ km s$^{-1}$. AGNs were selected by cross-matching PAUS galaxies with multi-wavelength AGN catalogues, yielding 270 AGNs in pairs out of a parent sample of 8,880 AGNs in PAUS. We constructed control samples of isolated AGNs; non-AGNs in pairs; and isolated non-AGNs matched in redshift, absolute magnitude, and environment. Results. Active galactic nuclei in pairs show progressively redder rest-frame colours with increasing redshift, particularly at redshifts of $z\gtrsim 0.5$, whereas isolated AGNs and non-AGNs in pairs show no significant colour evolution and remain at $\mathrm{M_g-M_r}\sim0.65$. Pairs hosting AGNs are also preferentially morphologically disturbed interacting systems found at smaller projected separations and velocity offsets, consistent with more dynamically advanced interactions. Conclusions. These results provide evidence of a redshift-dependent link between galaxy interactions and AGN activity, suggesting that interactions play an increasingly important role in triggering nuclear activity at intermediate redshifts. This study highlights the unique capability of PAUS to probe AGN-galaxy interaction connections beyond the local Universe with unprecedented statistical power.

title: Cross-Validation of Infrasound Detections and Fireball Observations from the Global Fireball Observatory
background_knowledge: 该研究属于流星天文学与行星科学中的大气进入物理方向。流星体以每秒十几至几十公里的速度进入地球大气后，在约 80–120 km 高度发生强烈压缩、加热、烧蚀、电离与碎裂，形成可供光学观测的火流星。高速进入会在流星体前方和周围激发弹道激波；若流星体发生突然碎裂，还会产生近似离散点源的爆炸式声波。这些过程激发的大气声波中，频率很低的部分（约 20 Hz 以下，即次声）能够沿大气波导传播数百至数千公里，因而可被地面次声台阵记录。次声台阵通过多个传感器的相干信号、到达方位角、视速度和波形特征识别事件，并结合大气射线追踪反演源高度与传播路径。另一方面，光学火流星相机网络可对同一事件进行三角定位，给出精确轨迹、速度、光变曲线与轨道，从而估算进入能量和质量。将光学与次声观测交叉验证，有助于回答何种火流星能够产生可检测次声、信号究竟来自连续弹道激波还是离散碎裂，以及源特性、大气传播条件和源-接收器几何如何共同决定可检测性。
contribution: 论文利用全球火流星观测网（Global Fireball Observatory，GFO）在澳大利亚西部与美国加利福尼亚的观测资料，在 11 年时间内筛选出近 300 个轨迹约束良好、且位于某个次声台阵 500 km 范围内的火流星事件，其中 **20 个火流星与次声探测实现了可靠关联**。作者对这些事件估算能量，利用大气射线追踪模拟约束次声源高度，并采用多诊断方法分析源机制，重点判别记录到的次声信号来自圆柱形线源（弹道激波）还是离散碎裂事件。结果显示，**被次声探测到的火流星在动力学与物理性质上覆盖很宽的范围，表明次声可检测性由源特性、大气传播条件和源-接收器几何共同决定，而非由单一进入参数主导**；对激波源机制的分析还发现，**弹道激波与碎裂相关源贡献大致相当**。这些结果 **展示了联合次声与光学观测在稳健约束流星体激波产生过程方面的价值**。
summary: How do infrasound signals from fireballs relate to atmospheric entry conditions and the physical properties of their parents meteoroids? In this study, we investigate the detectability of infrasound generated by local-to-regional fireballs and use the associated signals to constrain meteoroid physical properties. Across Western Australia and California, the Global Fireball Observatory (GFO) recorded nearly 300 fireball events with well-constrained trajectories within 500 km of an infrasound array over an 11-year period. Of these, 20 fireballs were confidently associated with infrasound detections. For these events, we estimate energies, constrain source altitudes using atmospheric ray-tracing simulations, and investigate source mechanisms using a multi-diagnostic approach. In particular, we examine whether the recorded infrasonic signals originated from cylindrical line sources (ballistic shocks) or discrete fragmentation episodes. Our results show that infrasound-detected fireballs span a broad range of dynamical and physical properties. This variability indicates that infrasound detectability is governed by a combination of source characteristics, atmospheric propagation conditions, and source-receiver geometry, rather than any single entry parameter. Analysis of the fireball shock source mechanisms reveals an even contribution from both ballistic and fragmentation-related sources. These results also demonstrate the value of combining infrasound and optical observations for robust constraints on meteoroid shock generation processes.

title: Uncertainty estimation of incoming comet trajectories with a thermophysical non-gravitational force model for Comet Interceptor encounter planning
background_knowledge: 彗星是太阳系中富含挥发分的冰质小天体，靠近太阳时表面冰升华形成气体包层与尘埃尾。升华喷流不仅改变彗星亮度与形态，还会对彗核产生非引力加速度（non-gravitational acceleration，NGA），使其轨道偏离纯引力预报。对于长周期彗星或动力学新彗星，人类往往在发现后不久便要规划近距离飞掠，因此轨迹预报必须同时处理观测天测误差、彗核自转与活动分布、以及随日心距变化的活动演化。常用做法是用地面天体测量得到的天体位置拟合轨道，并加入 NGA 模型或热物理模型来约束喷流引起的加速度；其核心困难在于 NGA 的长期演化难以外推，且目标彗星在遭遇前的活动可能快速增强。
contribution: 论文面向欧洲空间局（ESA）Comet Interceptor 任务，该任务将飞掠一颗尚未确定的 incoming 长周期或动力学新彗星，因此需要高精度轨迹预报。作者用 Monte Carlo 抽样的热物理非引力加速度模型生成参考轨迹，并检验地面天体测量与标准 NGA 拟合技术能否在飞掠前预测彗星的位置和速度。结果表明，由于 NGA 演化难以预测，且合理模拟的天体测量精度有限，**在飞掠前 60 天达到 1000 km 位置精度和 1 m s$^{-1}$ 速度精度的任务目标并不可期**；作者建议将不确定度放宽到 **10,000 km 和数 m s$^{-1}$**。当彗星在 incoming 的几个 AU 处排气活动陡峭上升时，NGA 拟合难以再现参考加速度与轨迹，但随着观测延伸至近日点，拟合最终会收敛，**即使只有半个轨道弧段，也能较好估计许多 underlying acceleration parameters**。
summary: The European Space Agency Comet Interceptor mission is designed to fly-by an as-yet undetermined incoming long-period or dynamically-new comet, which will require an accurate prediction of its trajectory. Cometary orbits are perturbed from purely gravitational trajectories by non-gravitational accelerations (NGAs) stemming from their outgassing, however, and these must be taken into account in the navigation. We here test the ability of ground-based astrometry and standard NGA-fitting techniques to predict the position and velocity of incoming comets perturbed by a Monte Carlo sampled thermophysical acceleration model. We find that, due to the difficulties of predicting NGA evolution as well as the limitations of reasonably simulated astrometry, predicted accuracies are unlikely to meet the mission goals of 1000 km and 1 m s$^{-1}$ in position and velocity, sixty days before intercept. We instead recommend expanded uncertainties of $10,000$ km and several m s$^{-1}$. Our NGA fits struggle to reproduce the reference accelerations and trajectories when outgassing is rising steeply at a few AU-incoming, but with more observations up until perihelion, do eventually converge, leading to good estimates of many of the underlying acceleration parameters even for half an orbital arc.

title: Robust paths to primordial $B$ modes in the presence of polarised point source contamination
background_knowledge: 宇宙微波背景（CMB）极化是研究早期宇宙和基本物理的重要探针。在复合时期及再电离时期，光子与自由电子发生汤姆孙散射可产生线性极化；极化场按空间对称性可分解为 $E$ 模和 $B$ 模。原初 $B$ 模主要由暴胀时期产生的原初引力波留下，其幅度与张量-标量比 $r$ 相关，但信号极其微弱；同时，大尺度结构引力透镜会把部分 $E$ 模转化为透镜 $B$ 模，这既是重要科学信号，也是原初 $B$ 模探测中的混淆项。地面 CMB 实验通常依靠多频观测和成分分离，将宇宙学信号与银河系同步辐射、热尘埃极化以及河外极化点源分开。河外射电星系和活动星系核的同步辐射、尘埃恒星形成星系的尘埃发射，都会形成未分辨的极化点源；若未加处理，会在功率谱和参数推断中引入偏置。常用策略包括掩模亮源、多频成分分离、对残余点源污染建模并在参数推断中边缘化。该领域的核心要求是同时保证参数估计无偏、误差可靠，并尽可能减少对统计精度的损失。
contribution: 本文研究极化河外点源对地面 CMB 实验中原初 $B$ 模探测的污染，并追踪其经过成分分离后对最终参数约束的影响。作者基于当前先进的模型生成包含河外射电源（ERS）和尘埃恒星形成星系（DSFG）极化发射的合成数据，并比较掩模与建模策略。结果表明：**DSFG 的贡献很可能小到不足以显著偏置宇宙学或前景参数**；**若不掩模，ERS 会偏置描述银河同步辐射和透镜 $B$ 模的成分参数**。对于目标噪声约 $\sigma_P \simeq 1\,\mu{\rm K}\,{\rm arcmin}$ 的实验，**掩模所有流量高于约 $0.1\,{\rm Jy}$ 的 ERS，并联合一个相对简单的残余点源模型进行边缘化**，能够在参数不确定度代价可忽略的情况下，稳健地恢复无偏的宇宙学与前景参数。
summary: A detection of primordial $B$ modes in the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) polarisation relies on a robust control and removal of contamination from astrophysical polarised foreground emission. We examine how much polarised extragalactic point sources may contaminate the cosmological signal in ground-based CMB experiments, propagating their impact through component separation to the final parameter constraints. We discuss masking and modelling strategies to ensure that the resulting constraints remain both accurate and precise under this source of contamination. We produce synthetic data containing polarised emission from extragalactic radio sources (ERSs) and dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) following state-of-the-art models for both samples. We find that, while the DSFG contribution is likely too small to cause any significant bias to the cosmological or foreground parameters, the ERS contribution instead, if left unmasked, leads to a bias in the parameters describing the Galactic synchrotron and lensing $B$-mode components. For experiments targeting noise levels of order $σ_P\simeq 1\,μK\,{\rm arcmin}$, we find that masking all ERSs with fluxes above $\sim$0.1 Jy, coupled with a relatively simple model to marginalise over residual point-source contamination, achieves a suitable balance that allows for the robust recovery of unbiased cosmological and foreground parameters at a negligible cost in parameter uncertainties.

title: Saxion Decay and Dark Radiation in the KSVZ Axion Model
background_knowledge: 在标准热大爆炸宇宙学中，早期宇宙的膨胀历史、热浴演化以及相对论性自由度数 $N_{\rm eff}$，是连接粒子物理与宇宙微波背景、轻元素丰度等观测的关键量。轴子（axion）是解决强 CP 问题的重要候选粒子：Peccei–Quinn（PQ）对称性在高温下破缺；随后，QCD 相变附近的显式破缺使轴子获得质量。KSVZ 模型通过引入重色费米子和标量场来实现 PQ 机制；PQ 标量场的径向模式称为 saxion，它的质量与宇宙演化会影响轴子丰度、暗辐射以及等曲率扰动。如果 PQ 场在暴胀期间发生位移，那么它的凝聚体会在宇宙膨胀中振荡并最终衰变；saxion 衰变产生的相对论性轴子可以贡献暗辐射，这类贡献通常用 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$ 表征。该方向需要追踪标量场从暴胀后初始条件到振荡、衰变和热化的演化，并结合 BBN 与 CMB 对 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$、轴子暗物质及等曲率扰动的限制。
contribution: 本文在四次型 KSVZ 轴子模型中计算由曲率位移的 Peccei–Quinn 凝聚体衰变产生的相对论性轴子能量密度。作者追踪径向 PQ 场（saxion）从暴胀极小值弛豫的过程，并利用其振荡的绝热作用量确定残留凝聚体丰度；随后演化凝聚体衰变为轴子和可见粒子，得到以 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$ 表示的暗辐射贡献。在仅包含一个重色 KSVZ 费米子且不加入额外 portal 相互作用时，**轴子道主导两个树级衰变模式**。两组参考历史给出 **$\Delta N_{\rm eff}\simeq0.033$** 和 **$0.12$**，对应的 saxion 能量份额上限分别低于 **$1\%$** 和 **$4\%$**。在固定四次耦合下，延长曲率释放持续时间会使预测的轴子辐射密度相对于可见辐射降低约 **28 倍**，同时保持原初等曲率振幅不变。
summary: We calculate the relativistic axion energy density produced by the decay of a curvature-displaced Peccei--Quinn condensate in a quartic KSVZ model. We follow the radial PQ field (the saxion) as it relaxes from its inflationary minimum and determine the surviving condensate abundance from the adiabatic action of its oscillations. We then evolve the condensate through its decay into axions and visible particles to calculate the resulting dark-radiation contribution, expressed as $ΔN_{\rm eff}$. With one heavy coloured KSVZ fermion and no additional portal interactions included, the axion channel dominates the two tree-level decay modes. Two reference histories yield $ΔN_{\rm eff}\simeq0.033$ and $0.12$, with maximum saxion energy fractions below $1\%$ and $4\%$, respectively. At fixed quartic coupling, increasing the duration of curvature release reduces the predicted axion radiation density relative to visible radiation by a factor of approximately $28$ while preserving the primordial isocurvature amplitude.

title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning for JWST Galaxy Images and Low Resolution Spectra
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究的核心目标之一，是测量星系在不同宇宙时代的恒星质量、恒星形成历史、金属丰度和尘埃含量，并理解这些性质如何随红移和环境演化。恒星质量通常不能直接观测，而需通过星系光谱能量分布（SED）推断：多波段测光或光谱分别约束连续谱形状、谱线特征和尘埃消光，但年龄、金属丰度与尘埃之间存在退化，且高红移星系暗弱、JWST 可用波段有限时，传统 SED 拟合容易不稳定。JWST 的 NIRCam 成像提供形态与空间分布信息，NIRSpec PRISM 低分辨率光谱提供连续谱和关键谱线信息，两者具有互补性。近年来，自监督学习可从无标签数据中学习通用表征，多模态对比学习（如 CLIP）可把图像和光谱对齐到共同嵌入空间，从而在观测数据稀疏时实现跨模态推断和物理量回归。
contribution: 论文提出一种自监督多模态模型，从缺少传统 SED 拟合所需多波段覆盖的稀疏 JWST 数据中恢复星系恒星质量。模型以单波段 F150W 成像与观测系 $1$–$2\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ PRISM 光谱配对训练，学习联合的图像—光谱表征，并在 $1<z\le3$ 处实现 **$R^2 \sim 0.9$、$\sigma_{\mathrm{NMAD}} = 0.24\ \mathrm{dex}$ 的恒星质量恢复**。进一步的跨模态 CLIP 对齐使单模态性能分别提升 **$\Delta R^2 = +0.04$（成像）** 与 **$+0.09$（光谱）**，**缩小了单模态推断与联合模态推断之间的差距**。代码与文档见 GitHub：https://github.com/2003cy/neurips2026_ssl_jwst。
summary: A self-supervised multimodal model recovers galaxy stellar masses from sparse JWST data that lack the multi-band coverage required by traditional SED fitting. We train on single-band F150W imaging paired with observed-frame 1-2 $μ$m PRISM spectra and obtain a joint image-spectrum representation that recovers stellar mass at $1<z\le3$ with $R^2 \sim 0.9$ and $σ_{\mathrm{NMAD}} = 0.24$ dex; cross-modal CLIP alignment further raises single-modality performance by $ΔR^2 = +0.04$ (imaging) and $+0.09$ (spectroscopy), narrowing the gap to joint-modality inference. The code and documentation are available at \href{https://github.com/2003cy/neurips2026_ssl_jwst}{GitHub}.

title: A Generalized Framework for Rapid Polarization Response Generation in Wide Field-of-View Compton Polarimeters
background_knowledge: 伽马射线暴（GRB）的瞬发辐射在几十 keV 到约 1 MeV 能段最亮，但其辐射机制与磁场几何仍不清楚。偏振测量通过探测电子康普顿散射的方位角分布，直接约束辐射机制和磁场结构。康普顿偏振仪利用方位散射角分布（ASAD）的 180° 调制；传统分析常用轴上调制因子 $\mu_{100}$ 描述偏振响应。对于宽视场平面偏振仪，GRB 常以离轴方向入射，Klein-Nishina 散射截面投影会在 ASAD 中引入高次谐波，且探测阈值、入射角与偏振角都会改变响应。因此，需要在整个瞬发能段、任意入射与偏振角下精确建模偏振响应，并用 GEANT4 等蒙特卡洛模拟校验；但全模拟计算量大，发展快速而准确的响应生成框架对宽视场偏振观测尤为关键。
contribution: 本文对 Muleri（2014）提出的宽视场平面康普顿偏振仪离轴 Klein-Nishina 投影进行无近似数值计算，覆盖整个 GRB 瞬发能段以及任意入射角和偏振角；量化单一调制因子无法刻画的高次谐波，并计入探测阈值对 ASAD 的影响，且用理想偏振仪的 GEANT4 模拟验证模型。以 POLAR 为案例，作者提出两种仅需少量蒙特卡洛模拟即可构建完整偏振响应的模式：**模式 1 只需每个能量点的非偏振模拟，即可在除最亮 GRB 外复现 POLAR 全 GEANT4 响应得到的偏振测量，但对最亮 GRB 会低估偏振度；模式 2 额外加入每个能量点两个不同角度的偏振模拟，可将模拟 ASAD 复现到统计噪声水平，并准确复现所有测试 GRB 的偏振。两种模式均以开源软件发布，适用于任意平面康普顿偏振仪，且至少减少 95% 的蒙特卡洛模拟量。**
summary: Polarimetry is the most direct probe of the unsettled radiation mechanism and magnetic field structure of gamma-ray burst (GRB) prompt emission at the energies where it peaks, tens of keV to about 1 MeV. Compton polarimeters use the azimuthal scattering angle distribution (ASAD), a 180 degree modulation on axis. GRB measurements have largely relied on the on-axis modulation factor $μ_{100}$. For a wide field-of-view planar polarimeter, GRBs arrive off axis, where the Klein-Nishina projection adds harmonics to the ASAD. Muleri (2014) described this projection and evaluated it in a low-energy expansion for X-rays. We evaluate it numerically without approximation over the whole prompt-emission energy band for any incidence and polarization angles, quantify the off-axis harmonics a single modulation factor cannot capture, and verify the model against GEANT4 simulations of an ideal polarimeter. We also include the effect of the detection threshold on the ASAD. With POLAR as the case study, we present two modes that build the full polarization response with at least 95 percent fewer Monte Carlo simulations. Mode 1 takes only the unpolarized simulation per energy and recovers the polarization measured with POLAR's full GEANT4 responses for all but the brightest GRBs, where it underestimates the polarization degree. Mode 2 adds two polarized simulations per energy at distinct angles and reproduces the simulated ASADs to their statistical noise and the polarization of every GRB tested. Both modes are released as open-source software for any planar Compton polarimeter.

title: The Pandora SmallSat: post-launch operations and mission update
background_knowledge: 系外行星大气研究是当前天体物理学的重要前沿。当行星从恒星前方经过（凌星）时，少量恒星光会穿过行星大气，并在不同波长被不同分子、原子和云霾吸收或散射；通过测量凌星深度随波长的变化，即透射光谱，可以反推大气成分。HST 和 JWST 等高精度空间望远镜使这一类观测成为可能，但其精度受恒星自身活动限制。恒星表面黑子、谱斑等光球不均匀性会产生随波长变化的信号，可能被误判为行星大气吸收，尤其对低质量行星或小质量恒星系统影响显著。因此，研究范式逐渐从单纯高精度光谱测量扩展到“行星—恒星联合建模”：利用同时或准同时的多波段测光与光谱监测恒星变化，约束黑子覆盖率与温度结构，再将恒星污染从行星透射信号中分离出来。小卫星任务可以以较低成本提供长时标、多波段、与空间望远镜协同的观测，为该问题提供关键补充。
contribution: Pandora SmallSat 是 NASA 支持的一项空间小卫星任务，目标是研究系外行星大气。论文指出，透射光谱是未来十年识别系外行星大气组成的最佳途径之一，也是 HST 与 JWST 的关键科学驱动；但恒星黑子造成的光球不均匀性会污染高精度光谱。Pandora 通过可见光通道在覆盖恒星自转周期的长时标上开展测光观测，并同步用近红外通道获取光谱，以约束系外行星宿主星的黑子覆盖率，**从而在透射光谱中分离恒星信号与行星信号，可靠确定系外行星大气成分**。任务将观测从地球大小到木星大小的系外行星，宿主星覆盖中 K 型至晚 M 型。Pandora 于 2021 年初入选 NASA 首届 Astrophysics Pioneers Program；本文概述其科学目标、任务运行（包括发射后运行方案）、天文台、科学规划，以及为 2025 年发射就绪做准备的关键里程碑。
summary: The Pandora SmallSat is a NASA flight project designed to study the atmospheres of exoplanets. Transmission spectroscopy of transiting exoplanets provides our best opportunity to identify the makeup of planetary atmospheres in the coming decade, and is a key science driver for HST and JWST. Stellar photospheric inhomogeneity due to star spots, however, has been shown to contaminate the observed spectra in these high-precision measurements. Pandora will address the problem of stellar contamination by collecting long-duration photometric observations sampled over a stellar rotation period with a visible-light channel and simultaneous spectra with a near-IR channel. These simultaneous multiwavelength observations will constrain star spot covering fractions of exoplanet host stars, enabling star and planet signals to be disentangled in transmission spectra to then reliably determine exoplanet atmosphere compositions. Pandora will observe exoplanets with sizes ranging from Earth-size to Jupiter-size and host stars spanning mid-K to late-M spectral types. Pandora was selected in early 2021 as part of NASA's inaugural Astrophysics Pioneers Program. Herein, we present an overview of the mission, including the science objectives, operations, the observatory, science planning, and upcoming milestones as we prepare for launch readiness in 2025.

title: A Technical Reanalysis of the Viking Carbon Assimilation-Pyrolytic Release Experiment
background_knowledge: Viking 1976 火星生物学实验包旨在原位检验火星土壤是否具有代谢或碳同化活动，包含气体交换实验、标记释放实验（Labeled Release, LR）、碳同化-热解释放实验（Carbon Assimilation-Pyrolytic Release, CAPyR）以及气相色谱-质谱仪（GCMS）。CAPyR 将火星土壤暴露于含 $^{14}\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ 与 $^{14}\mathrm{CO}$ 的气氛中培养，随后以升温吹扫去除未固定或易挥发标记，再高温热解土壤；若部分 $^{14}\mathrm{C}$ 已被固定为还原态有机碳，热解时可释放并进入检测。实验以 Peak 1 记录未捕集的放射性挥发物，以 Peak 2 记录被有机蒸气阱保留、再氧化后测得的放射性，净 Peak 2 被设计为生物碳同化信号的代理。该领域的关键争议在于：火星土壤中的非生物化学过程，尤其是后来发现可能普遍存在的高氯酸盐、矿物表面催化和氧化性物种，能否重现 Viking 观测到的热敏感标记固定与释放模式；这直接关系到 Viking 生物学实验结果是否提供了生命信号证据。
contribution: 本文对 Viking CAPyR 实验作技术性再分析。九次可用培养中有 **七次在 Chryse Planitia 与 Utopia Planitia 产生显著净 Peak 2 信号，包括暗色 U1 运行样**；Viking Lander 2 一个此前报道不足的气体泄漏给 U1–U3 带来不确定性。C1 信号在假设碳完全来自 CO 或 CO$_2$ 时，分别约对应 10 pmol 或 30 pmol 碳。作者结合 Viking 土壤可能含高氯酸盐的背景重新评估这些结果：热解过程中已固定有机放射性碳被氧化，可能把标记从 Peak 2 转移到 Peak 1，这是以往 CAPyR 分析未考虑的高氯酸盐特异效应。Hubbard（1979）的矿物基质实验能产生非生物 Peak 2 信号，但未重现热敏感性；**目前尚无已证明的非生物机制能在火星相关条件下重现全部 CAPyR 观测**。这些观测仍与一种生物碳同化系统相符：其相关活动能经受 C5 的 120 °C/90 °C 预处理，却被 C2 的 175 °C 预处理强烈削弱。与标记释放实验结合，CAPyR 暗示来自同一火星土壤采集的不同分样中存在氧化性与还原性化学过程；代谢活跃生命可耦合这两类过程，而**对二者联合的热不稳定响应模式给出定量非生物解释仍有待证明**。
summary: The 1976 Viking Carbon Assimilation-Pyrolytic Release (CAPyR) experiment tested whether carbon from $^{14}$CO$_2$ and $^{14}$CO entered Martian soil during a 120-hour incubation in a form retained during a 120 $^\circ$C purge but released by pyrolysis at 635 $^\circ$C. Untrapped radioactivity was measured as Peak 1; material retained in an organic vapor trap was oxidized and measured as Peak 2. Net Peak 2 was intended to represent synthesized reduced organic carbon. Seven of nine usable incubations at Chryse and Utopia Planitia yielded significant net Peak 2 signals, including the dark U1 run. An underreported Viking Lander 2 gas leak introduces uncertainty into U1-U3. The C1 signal corresponds to approximately 10 or 30 pmol of carbon, assuming derivation entirely from CO or CO$_2$, respectively. We reassess these results in light of the possible presence of perchlorate salts in Viking soils. Oxidation of fixed organic radiocarbon during pyrolysis could have shifted label from Peak 2 to Peak 1, a perchlorate-specific effect not considered in previous CAPyR analyses. Hubbard's (1979) mineral-substrate experiments produced abiotic Peak 2 signals without reproducing the heat sensitivity. No demonstrated abiotic mechanism has reproduced all CAPyR observations under Mars-relevant conditions. The observations remain consistent with a biological carbon-assimilation system whose relevant activity survives C5's 120 $^\circ$C/90 $^\circ$C pretreatment but is strongly impaired by C2's 175 $^\circ$C pretreatment. Together with the Labeled Release experiment, CAPyR suggests oxidative and reductive chemistry in separate aliquots from common Martian soil acquisitions. Metabolically active life combines these processes; a quantitative abiotic explanation of their combined heat-labile response patterns remains to be demonstrated.

title: Nuclear Millimeter Continuum Emission in Radio-Quiet Active Galactic Nuclei: an ALMA Spectral and Variability Study
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积驱动，其多波段辐射来自吸积盘、热 X 射线冕、尘埃环和喷流等不同区域。射电宁静（radio-quiet, RQ）AGN 的射电和毫米波段通常远弱于射电强（radio-loud）对象，但高灵敏度观测仍常探测到未分辨的毫米连续谱。理解其起源需要区分热尘埃、自由-自由发射与相对论电子的同步辐射等机制；其中，紧凑 X 射线冕中的自吸收同步辐射和弱喷流是主要候选。对幂律谱 $F_\nu \propto \nu^\alpha$ 的谱指数测量、短时标流量变化以及亮度温度估计，可用于限制辐射机制和发射区尺度。ALMA 的宽频带、高灵敏度与准同时观测能力，使系统比较毫米谱与 X 射线辐射、检验冕与毫米波段联系成为可能。
contribution: 论文利用 ALMA 对 9 个近邻（$z \sim 0.008-0.064$）射电宁静 AGN 开展准同时的 100、145 与 233 GHz 观测，并对谱能量分布做幂律拟合，得到毫米谱指数范围为 $-0.05^{+0.09}_{-0.09}$ 至 $0.88^{+0.12}_{-0.11}$。每个源在两个相隔 $4-11$ 天的 100 GHz 历元中被观测，其中 3/9 个源显示出 30–56% 的流量密度变化（显著性 $>3\sigma$）。**仅凭谱斜率不足以确定毫米辐射起源；但观测到的短时标变化和推断的亮度温度与来自尺度为 $R_{\rm mm}<10^3-10^4 R_{\rm g}$ 的致密非热发射区（如 X 射线冕或紧凑喷流）相符。** 作者还发现样本中 100/233 GHz 与 X 射线通量存在明显相关，并建立了 145 GHz 与 X 射线之间的新线性相关。
summary: Unresolved millimeter (mm) emission is observed in radio-quiet (RQ) Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN), but its physical origin remains debated. Self-absorbed synchrotron emission from the compact X-ray corona is one of the leading candidates. Previous support for this coronal synchrotron origin has mainly been based on variability and spectral indices in a few RQ AGN, with a lack of (quasi-)simultaneous broadband data for larger samples. We present Atacama Large Millimeter/sub-millimeter Array (ALMA) observations of nine nearby ($z \sim 0.008-0.064$) RQ AGN, obtained quasi-simultaneously at 100, 145, and 233 GHz. Based on power-law fits to the spectral energy distributions, we measure millimeter spectral indices ranging from $-0.05^{+0.09}_{-0.09}$ to $0.88^{+0.12}_{-0.11}$. Furthermore, across two 100 GHz observing epochs per source, separated by $4-11$ days, we detect flux density variability of $30-56$% (>$3σ$ significance level) in three out of nine sources. Spectral slopes alone are insufficient to constrain the origin of the millimeter emission; however, the observed short-timescale variability and inferred brightness temperature values are consistent with a non-thermal emission mechanism arising from a compact emitting region with a size of $R_{\rm mm}< 10^3 - 10^4 R_{\rm g}$, such as the corona or a compact jet. Furthermore, we find a clear correlation between the 100/233 GHz and X-ray flux in our sample, and establish a new linear correlation between 145 GHz and X-ray emission.

title: The black hole-galaxy correlations of the 12 micron local AGN sample: a NuSTAR perspective
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞吸积供能，其黑洞质量 $M_{\rm BH}$ 与宿主星系性质的联系是理解黑洞—星系共同演化的重要观测约束。对于不活动星系， $M-\sigma$ 关系（黑洞质量与恒星速度弥散的相关）被广泛用作黑洞质量的间接标尺，并用于校准回响映射（RM）、进而支撑单历元法；在窄线 AGN 中， $M-\sigma$ 关系甚至常被直接用于估计 $M_{\rm BH}$。然而，AGN 样本可能存在选择效应、宽线区遮蔽与吸积状态差异，因此不活动星系标定的关系能否可靠外推到 Seyfert 1、Seyfert 2 和隐藏宽线区星系（HBLR）仍需检验。硬 X 射线观测（如 NuSTAR）受尘埃遮蔽影响较小，可提供吸积盘与日冕信息；X 射线标度法利用这些观测量可在中高吸积率 AGN 中估计黑洞质量。12 $\mu$m 样本在本地宇宙中具有较好的代表性和较低偏差，为检验上述标定问题提供了合适样本。
contribution: 本文利用具有本地代表性和较低选择偏差的 12 $\mu$m AGN 样本（涵盖 Seyfert 1、Seyfert 2 与隐藏宽线区星系 HBLR），并借助其中 NuSTAR 硬 X 射线数据质量较好的子样本，采用适用于中高吸积率 AGN 的 X 射线标度法估计 $M_{\rm BH}$，检验由不活动星系标定的 $M-\sigma$ 关系能否可靠外推到本地 AGN 群体。结果发现，**12 $\mu$m AGN 样本的 $M-\sigma$ 关系不同于不活动星系，且弥散显著，因而其作为 $M_{\rm BH}$ 间接估计量的预测能力相当有限**。基于该样本得到的 **$M_{\rm BH}-M_{\rm gal}$ 关系与大样本近邻 Type 1 AGN 的结果一致，而与不活动星系的结果不一致**。此外，结果提供了提示性证据：**Seyfert 1 与 HBLR 具有相似且系统性高于 Seyfert 2 的爱丁顿比**。
summary: The M-sigma correlation of inactive galaxies plays a crucial role in estimating the black hole mass (MBH) in active galactic nuclei (AGN): 1) it is used to calibrate the reverberation mapping (RM) method; 2) the RM is the basis of the single epoch method, the most-used technique to determine MBH of broad-line AGN; and 3) in narrow-line AGN, MBH is often directly inferred from the M-sigma correlation. The main goal of this work is to test whether the M-sigma relation calibrated from inactive galaxies can be reliably applied to a local AGN population spanning Seyfert 1, Seyfert 2, and hidden broad-line region galaxies (HBLRs), and whether the resulting AGN relation has sufficient predictive power to be used as an indirect MBH estimator. To investigate this hypothesis, we used the 12 micron AGN sample, a local representative and largely unbiased sample. Since a substantial fraction of this sample has good-quality NuSTAR data, we estimated their MBH with the X-ray scaling method, which works for any AGN accreting at moderate or high level. We find that the M-sigma correlation of the 12 micron AGN sample is different from the one obtained with inactive galaxies and has a substantial scatter. Therefore, its predictive power for MBH estimates is fairly limited. We also find that the MBH-Mgal correlation based on the 12 micron AGN sample is consistent with the analogous correlation obtained from a large sample of nearby type 1 AGN and inconsistent with that of inactive galaxies. Finally, we find suggestive evidence that Seyfert 1 and HBLRs have similar and systematically higher Eddington ratios than Seyfert 2 galaxies.

title: Gone Without a Bang: A Search for Failed Core-Collapse Supernovae in ZTF and Predictions for Rubin and Roman
background_knowledge: 大质量恒星（$M \gtrsim 10\ M_\odot$）在生命末期会形成铁核，核心失去压力支撑后发生引力坍缩。经典图像认为，坍缩会在强 neutrino 加热等机制下驱动外层爆发，形成核心坍缩超新星；但在部分情形下，爆发可能失败，物质直接落入新生黑洞，恒星于光学波段“消失”，即失败的核心坍缩超新星（failed core-collapse supernova，FccSN）。这类事件是连接大质量恒星演化、超新星爆发机制与黑洞形成的重要环节。观测上，宽视场时域巡天通过重复成像监测恒星亮度，寻找前身星突然变暗且不再恢复的“消失”事件；其难点在于区分真正的直接坍缩与红外观测、尘埃遮蔽、变星、AGN 活动等造成的伪信号。统计上，FccSN 的发生率还可与恒星初始质量函数、类银河系星系中的星族形成历史及巡天探测效率相结合，从而预言未来 LSST、Roman 等设施可探测的事件数。
contribution: 论文利用分段线性函数模型搜索整个 ZTF 光学测光目录中的 FccSNe，得到 125 个通量显著下凹且顶部与底部平坦的光变下降源（faders）。尽管**未发现可确证候选体**，但部分源呈现可能暗示直接坍缩事件的值得关注特征。基于零结果，作者计算出在 $99\%$ 置信度下，**银河系内 FccSNe 的最大统计发生率为每世纪 147 次**。为解释该结果，论文模拟类银河系星系中的星族形成，预测 ZTF 每世纪可观测到 **$0.234 \pm 0.006$ 个 FccSNe**，与 ZTF 尚缺确证观测相符；并进一步预测，LSST 与 Roman 空间望远镜宽场仪器（WFI）的类似监测有望实现对近邻 FccSNe 的族群级研究。
summary: The core-collapse of massive stars (${\geq}10\ \rm M_\odot$) usually takes the form of a supernova, but in some cases may lead to a direct collapse, leading to a failed core-collapse supernova (FccSN). Wide-field time-domain surveys, such as the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF), are a useful tool to find such ``disappearing" stars. We use a piecewise linear function model to search the entire ZTF optical photometric catalog for FccSNe, yielding 125 ``faders" that dip significantly with a flat top and bottom flux. Although no candidates were definitively found, some of the sources exhibit promising behavior that may indicate a direct collapse event. Assuming a null result from the search, we calculate at 99\% credibility that the maximum statistical rate of FccSNe in the Milky Way is 147 per century. To contextualize these findings, we also simulate the formation of stellar populations in Milky Way-like galaxies to estimate the expected number of FccSNe observable by ZTF. This simulation predicts ZTF to observe $0.234\pm0.006$ FccSNe per century, which aligns with the lack of definitive observations in ZTF. However, we predict that similar monitoring using the Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) and the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope's Wide Field Instrument (WFI) could enable population-level studies of nearby FccSNe.

title: Impact of Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus merger revealed by a single cosmic clock: thick-to-thin disc transition, gas disc shrinking and bar formation
background_knowledge: 银河系考古学通过恒星年龄、化学丰度和运动学，把银河系的组装史分解为若干并合事件与内禀演化过程。银河系盘通常分为厚盘与薄盘：厚盘在运动学上更热、年龄更老，薄盘更冷且以较年轻恒星为主；两者的转变时间记录了早期并合加热、气体耗散与恒星形成历史。Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus（GSE）是银河系最近一次重要并合，发生在约 8–10 Gyr 前，它在银晕中留下大量高偏心率、低角动量恒星，也可能加热原盘、触发星暴并影响厚盘形成。内银河系的棒结构对气体内流、核区恒星形成和盘动力学至关重要，但其形成时间以及是否由 GSE 触发仍有争议。常用办法是以核星盘（NSD）的恒星形成历史推断棒形成，而 Mira 变星可作为示踪 NSD 恒星形成的“宇宙钟”；GSE 合并时间则常由红巨星的年龄–金属丰度关系估计。然而，Mira 变星与红巨星依赖不同的年龄标尺，不能直接比较，这是本文要解决的关键问题。
contribution:
论文用同一套年龄尺度重新校准 Mira 变星的周期–年龄关系，以检验银河系棒形成与 GSE 合并的时间联系。作者将 Mira 周期–年龄关系标定到 APOGEE 红巨星的年龄尺度上；后者的年龄来自以 Kepler 星震年龄训练的贝叶斯神经网络。随后，他们用参数随周期变化的、基于作用量的准等温分布函数拟合 2394 个富氧盘 Mira 变星的 Gaia DR3 自行，并把其垂直速度弥散随周期的变化与 Funakoshi et al.（2025）中 APOGEE 红巨星的垂直速度弥散随年龄的变化相匹配，从而导出新的周期–年龄关系。
\n结果显示，**核星盘恒星形成的上升与峰值位于红巨星年龄尺度上的约 8.5–10.5 Gyr 前**；这一时段**与 GSE 诱导星暴的最后阶段、厚盘到薄盘转变以及恒星形成气体盘的收缩相重叠**。若核星盘的恒星形成可示踪棒形成，这些时间重合提示一种可能情景：**GSE 合并可能“播种”了银河系棒的形成**；同时，**GSE 供应的新鲜气体和由其潮汐力矩驱动的外盘气体内流，可能提高了内银河系的重子主导程度**。
summary: Whether the formation of the Galactic bar was connected to the Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus (GSE) merger, the last significant merger experienced by the Milky Way, remains an open question. The bar formation epoch has been inferred from the star formation history of the nuclear stellar disc (NSD) traced by Mira variables, and the GSE merger epoch from the age-metallicity relation of red giants. However, these epochs rest on different stellar tracers with different age scales and cannot be compared directly. We recalibrate the Mira period-age relation onto the age scale of APOGEE red giants, with ages from a Bayesian neural network trained on Kepler asteroseismic ages. We fit the Gaia DR3 proper motions of 2394 O-rich disc Mira variables with an action-based quasi-isothermal distribution function whose parameters vary with period, and derive the period-age relation by matching their vertical velocity dispersion as a function of period to that of the APOGEE red giants as a function of age in Funakoshi et al. (2025). This places the NSD star-formation rise and peak at 8.5-10.5 Gyr ago on the red giant age scale, overlapping with the final stage of the GSE-induced starburst, thick-to-thin disc transition and the contraction of the star-forming gas disc. If NSD star formation traces bar formation, these coincidences suggest a possible scenario in which the GSE seeded the bar formation, while fresh gas supplied by the GSE and outer disc gas driven inward by its tidal torques, increased the baryonic dominance of the inner Galaxy.

title: The deepest X-ray view of a kiloparsec scale jet at z=6.1
background_knowledge:
活动星系核（AGN）是由超大质量黑洞吸积驱动的明亮天体，其中一部分会抛出准直的相对论性喷流。喷流可从黑洞附近延伸到 kpc 乃至 Mpc 尺度，是研究黑洞自旋、吸积—喷流耦合、粒子加速以及 AGN 反馈的重要探针。对喷流的高能辐射，常见解释包括电子在磁场中的同步辐射、同步自康普顿散射，以及相对论电子对宇宙微波背景光子的逆康普顿散射（IC/CMB）；后者在高红移尤为重要，因为 CMB 能量密度随 $(1+z)^4$ 增长。
\nX 射线观测能够直接约束喷流中高能电子的分布、磁场、束流因子和辐射机制。观测上常把喷流分解为核心与延展成分：核心辐射受多普勒增强，谱常较硬；延展的 kpc 尺度结构则更接近内禀喷流辐射，谱往往更软。光子指数 $\Gamma$ 描述幂律能谱 $N(E) \propto E^{-\Gamma}$，$\Gamma$ 越大表示谱越软。高红移、大尺度 X 射线喷流十分稀少，且表面亮度低，需要 Chandra 这类亚角秒分辨率、低背景的 X 射线望远镜，并结合多波段数据与辐射模型来区分不同机制；未来更高灵敏度、角秒级分辨率的 X 射线任务有望把样本扩展到更暗、更远的目标。
contribution:
作者利用新的 Chandra 观测并结合档案数据，将总曝光时间提高到 360 ks，对 $z = 6.1$ 的 AGN PSO J030947.49+271757.31 的大尺度喷流进行了目前最深的 X 射线研究。增加曝光后，作者**把延展 X 射线辐射分辨为两个彼此分离、轻微延展的成分**，并开展空间分辨光谱分析。延展辐射的光子指数为 $\Gamma = 2.25^{+0.45}_{-0.44}$，明显比核心的 $\Gamma = 1.86 \pm 0.09$ 更软；延展成分与核心的光度比为 18%。基于 Chandra 图像的模拟显示，类似 AXIS 的下一代 X 射线任务可将探测到的光子统计量提高约 17 倍。
\n该工作**将 kpc 尺度喷流分解为两个主要成分并限制其能谱性质**，确认它是**当前已知最遥远、且 X 射线光度最高的大尺度喷流之一**。作者指出，具有角秒级角分辨率的未来 X 射线任务可对这类系统开展更精细研究，并揭示 Chandra 难以探测的更暗高红移喷流群体。
summary:
The mechanism responsible for the high-energy emission observed in kiloparsec-scale jets across cosmic time remains poorly understood. The relativistic jet associated with the z=6.1 AGN PSO J030947.49+271757.31 is the highest-redshift large-scale jet currently resolved in X-rays, providing a unique opportunity to study these structures.
  We present new Chandra observations, combined with archival data, for a total exposure of 360 ks. The increased exposure allowed us to resolve the extended X-ray emission into two distinct, slightly resolved components and perform spatially resolved spectral analyses.
  The extended emission has a photon index of Gamma = 2.25 (+0.45, -0.44), steeper than that of the core (Gamma = 1.86 +/- 0.09), and an extended-to-core luminosity ratio of 18%. Simulations using the Chandra image as input show that an AXIS-like mission could increase the detected photon statistics by a factor of approximately 17.
  We resolve the kiloparsec-scale jet into two main components and constrain its spectral properties. This is the most distant and one of the most X-ray-luminous large-scale jets currently known. Future X-ray missions with arcsecond-scale angular resolution could enable more detailed studies of such systems and reveal a population of fainter high-redshift jets beyond Chandra's reach.

title: Searching for substellar companion candidates with Gaia. V. M dwarfs within 15 pc studied with absolute astrometry, radial velocities, and direct imaging
background_knowledge: 该工作属于近邻 M 型矮星周围的系外行星与亚恒星伴星搜寻。M 型矮星是银河系中数量最多的恒星，质量低、半径小、温度低，其宜居带通常位于很近的轨道；围绕它们搜寻行星和褐矮星，有助于理解行星形成、轨道构型以及低质量恒星周围的行星发生率。亚恒星天体包括巨行星和褐矮星，质量低于约 0.08 $M_{\odot}$ 的天体不能维持稳定氢燃烧，而巨行星与褐矮星之间并无严格质量边界。探测依赖多方法互补：Gaia 的绝对天体测量可测量恒星在天球上绕共同质心的运动，未分辨伴星会造成天体测量超额噪声或自行异常（PMa），对中等周期、较大质量的伴星敏感；视向速度（RV）通过谱线多普勒摆动探测近距伴星；直接成像（DI）可在宽轨道上直接看到年轻或自身仍明亮的伴星。M 型星质量小，同样质量伴星造成的反射运动更大，且 15 pc 内的近邻样本便于高精度测距、RV 和 DI 后续观测。研究范式通常是从大规模天体测量目录筛选候选，再用 RV、DI 等独立数据验证，并在（质量，半长轴）参数空间给出探测极限，以区分行星、褐矮星与恒星伴星并排除假阳性。水冰线是原行星盘中挥发性物质凝结的边界，影响巨行星形成和观测目标选择。
contribution: 作者基于颜色、星等和天体测量数据质量，筛选了 15 pc 内由 Gaia 观测的 M 型星，并主要利用 Gaia 天体测量，在可用时结合自行异常（PMa）、视向速度（RV）和直接成像（DI）数据搜寻亚恒星伴星。使用 GaiaPMEX 工具对 582 颗 M 矮星进行分析后，作者识别出所有与 Gaia 超额信号相符的已知恒星和行星伴星；对每个新识别伴星，又利用归档 RV 和 DI 数据在（质量，半长轴）参数空间计算探测极限，以尽可能排除恒星伴星。天体测量允许的参数空间与 RV、DI 约束的联合分析，对伴星性质给出了严格限制。结果发现 156 颗 M 矮星在 Gaia 敏感范围内有束缚伴星，其中 37 颗和 7 颗的天体测量信号分别来自已知恒星伴星和已知亚恒星伴星；同时报告 35 颗新亚恒星伴星，其中至少 10 颗是轨道半长轴在 0.2 au 到 2 au 之间、质量接近 1 $M_{\mathrm{Jup}}$ 的巨行星，并另报告 77 颗亚恒星候选体。作者还为 50 颗具有已知系外行星、且无显著 Gaia 超额噪声的恒星给出天体测量 + RV + DI 的探测极限。该工作**在 M 型星周围揭示出一个显著的新亚恒星伴星族群，并对核心吸积模型提出挑战**；**这些结果将成为估计发生率和研究 M 矮星周围行星系统构型的重要输入**；部分位于水冰线之外的新伴星是 JWST 或 ELT 直接成像或星冕仪观测的优选目标。
summary: In this work, we survey M-type stars within 15 pc observed by Gaia based on their colour, magnitude, and quality of astrometric data. We aim to detect new substellar companions using primarily Gaia astrometry and, when available, proper-motion anomaly (PMa) along with radial velocity (RV) and direct imaging (DI) data. We used the GaiaPMEX tool to search for bound companions around 582 M dwarfs. We identified all previously known stellar and planetary companions that were consistent with the Gaia excess signal. Then for all newly identified companions, we computed detection limits in the (mass, semi-major axis) parameter space using archival RV and DI data, to possibly rule out the presence of a stellar companion. The joint analysis of the parameter space allowed by astrometry and constrained by RV and DI provides tight constraints on the nature of the companion. We found 156 M dwarfs to have a bound companion within the Gaia sensitivity domain. The astrometric signals of 37 and seven of them are due to known stellar and substellar companions, respectively. We report 35 new substellar companions among which at least ten giant planets orbiting between 0.2 au and 2 au, with masses close to 1 M_Jup. We also report 77 substellar candidates, and provide detection limits using astrometry+RV+DI for 50 stars with known exoplanets and no significant Gaia excess noise. This work reveals a significant population of new substellar companions to M-type stars, challenging core accretion models. These results will be crucial inputs for estimating occurrence rates and studying the architecture of planetary systems around M dwarfs. Some new companions presented here, located beyond the water ice line, are prime targets for DI or coronagraphy observations with JWST or ELT.

title: Multiwavelength Classification of Chandra Sources in Omega Centauri
background_knowledge: 球状星团是银河系晕中由引力束缚的致密恒星系统，拥有高恒星密度、复杂双星演化和丰富致密天体族群。其 X 射线辐射主要来自吸积致密天体的双星系统（如低质量 X 射线双星、灾变变星）、毫秒脉冲星及其伴星、以及活跃恒星冕等。Chandra 提供亚角秒级 X 射线定位，结合 HST 与 JWST 的光学/红外对应体、MeerKAT 的射电对应体，可通过多波段性质判定 X 射线源本质。研究范式通常包括高精度源匹配、多波段测光/光谱分类、以及利用已知源训练机器学习分类器；在星团核心等拥挤区域，因源密度高和对应体模糊，分类与匹配尤为困难。此类源族群还可用于检验星团动力学演化、质量分层、双星形成与破坏等物理过程。
contribution: 该工作对 NGC 5139（Omega Centauri）中的 Chandra X 射线源开展了迄今较全面的多波段分类研究，将 **200 多个 Chandra 源**与 HST、JWST 和 MeerKAT 的多波段星表交叉匹配。作者**首次在如此拥挤的恒星环境中应用机器学习分类流程 MUWCLASS**，并构建了球状星团专用训练集，汇总来自 **25 个银河系球状星团**中此前已分类的源。鉴于高密度环境带来的挑战，研究还将 MUWCLASS 结果与传统分类方法进行比较。结果**确认了前人工作提出的对应体关联，并识别出新的高置信度关联与候选关联**；论文进一步结合星团动力学演化以及双星形成/破坏模型讨论了这些分类结果的意义。
summary: We present a comprehensive study of X-ray sources in the globular cluster NGC 5139 to date. Over 200 Chandra sources are cross-matched to multiwavelength catalogs from HST, JWST, and MeerKAT. We employ a machine-learning classification pipeline (MUWCLASS) for the first time in such a crowded stellar environment and introduce the globular-cluster-specific training dataset, which compiles previously classified sources from 25 Galactic globular clusters. Given the challenges presented by the high-density environment, we compare the MUWCLASS results with traditional classification methods. We confirm counterpart associations suggested in previous works and also identify new confident and candidate associations. We discuss the implications of our classification results in light of models of cluster dynamical evolution and binary formation/destruction.

title: Rest-frame Ultraviolet Variability of Quasars in the Cosmic Himalayas Overdensity
background_knowledge: 类星体是中心超大质量黑洞吸积物质时产生的明亮活动星系核（AGN），其光学与紫外连续谱主要来自吸积盘内区。吸积盘和吸积流中的不稳定性会导致连续谱流量在数天至数年尺度上变化，因此紫外/光学光变是研究黑洞吸积物理并估计黑洞质量、吸积率的重要探针。观测上常用阻尼随机游走（DRW）模型和集合结构函数（SF）描述光变：DRW 给出阻尼时标 $\tau$ 与长期渐近振幅 $SF_{\infty}$，SF 则统计不同时间间隔下的典型流量变化。高红移星系过密区可能提高 AGN 的触发率和燃料供给；环境是否还会影响吸积流本身的变异性，是连接大尺度结构与黑洞吸积物理的重要问题。在 $z \sim 2.2$ 时，观测到的 $g$、$r$ 波段大致对应静止系紫外，因此可用多波段长期测光比较过密区类星体与普通类星体的紫外变异性。
contribution: 本文利用 Cosmic Himalayas（CH）过密区中 11 个 $z=2.16$ 至 $2.20$ 的 1 型类星体，构建了 1138 个 $z=2.11$ 至 $2.25$ 的 Stripe 82 类星体父样本，并结合 SDSS、PS1 与 ZTF 测光，得到观测者坐标系下最长约 27 年的 $g$、$r$ 波段光变曲线。作者将 CH 类星体的 DRW 参数和集合 SF 与在黑洞质量、Eddington 比上匹配的对照伪样本比较，并用注入—恢复模拟评估 CH 型偏移的可探测性。**CH 类星体倾向于具有更短的 DRW 阻尼时标（$g$ 与 $r$ 波段中位偏移分别为 $-0.32$ 与 $-0.13$ dex），且渐近振幅略高；但四项 DRW 比较均无统计显著性，其中最大的 $g$ 波段阻尼时标偏移也仅为 $p=0.16$。** 集合 SF 总体高于匹配对照的中位数，但每个波段 19 个时滞 bin 中有 18 个仍处于 95% 逐点包络之内。注入—恢复模拟表明，若真实存在均匀的 $-0.32$ dex $g$ 波段时标偏移，在约 60 个具有相近变异性弥散和数据质量的类星体下，获得名义 $3\sigma$ 探测的概率约为 80%。作者指出，若这些暂定偏移得到证实，可能意味着大尺度环境除影响类星体触发外，还会影响吸积流变异性；仍需 LSST 等更大样本、更高精度的光变曲线加以检验。
summary: Some high-redshift overdensities show an enhanced incidence of AGNs, suggesting that large-scale environment may influence supermassive black hole fuelling and triggering. Whether environment also affects AGN variability remains unclear.Using the Cosmic Himalayas (CH), an extreme concentration of 11 type 1 quasars at z=2.16-2.20, we investigate possible offsets in rest-frame ultraviolet variability relative to quasars with comparable redshifts, black hole masses, and Eddington ratios.We construct a parent sample of 1,138 Stripe 82 quasars at 2.11<=z<=2.25 and combine photometry from the SDSS, the PS1, and the ZTF to build observer-frame g- and r-band light curves spanning up to 27~yr. We compare DRW parameters and ensemble structure functions (SFs) with control pseudo-samples matched in black hole mass and Eddington ratio, and use injection--recovery simulations to forecast the detectability of a CH-like offset.The CH quasars show a tendency toward shorter DRW damping timescales (median offsets of -0.32 and -0.13 dex in g and r) and slightly higher asymptotic amplitudes. None of the four DRW comparisons is statistically significant, including the largest offset in the g-band damping timescale (p=0.16). Ensemble SFs generally exceed matched-control medians, although 18 of 19 lag bins per band remain within the 95% pointwise envelopes. Assuming a true uniform -0.32 dex g-band timescale offset, injection--recovery simulations predict an 80% probability of nominal 3sigma detection with approximately 60 quasars of comparable variability scatter and data quality.If confirmed, the tentative variability offsets may suggest that large-scale environment influences accretion-flow variability beyond its potential role in quasar triggering. Larger samples with higher-precision light curves, such as those expected from the LSST, are required to test this possibility.

title: A Potential New Dimension of Astrophysical Aromatic Functionalization: Phosphaethynyl (CP) Derivatives
background_knowledge: 星际介质与星周包层是低温、低密度的非平衡化学实验室，气相自由基—分子反应、离子—分子反应以及尘埃表面过程共同塑造分子丰度；射电波段的转动跃迁和红外波段的振动跃迁是识别这些分子的主要手段。多环芳烃（PAHs）及其衍生物被认为是星际碳库的重要组成，其红外发射带广泛见于星周与星系环境；向芳香骨架上引入取代基会改变对称性、偶极矩与光谱，从而影响可探测性。磷是生命关键元素，但星际磷化学仍不成熟，磷乙炔基（CP）自由基与 $c$-C$_3$H$_2$ 等含碳小分子已在星周包层中被探测，为研究富磷环境中的新分子提供了线索。量子化学计算可通过势能面与过渡态搜索判断低温反应可行性，并用耦合簇、四阶力场、二阶振动微扰理论或密度泛函理论预测振动频率、转动常数与偶极矩，从而指导红外和射电搜寻。
contribution: 论文用量子化学计算提出一条热力学可行、低温气相生成 $c$-C$_3$HCP 的路径：$c$-C$_3$H$_2$ 与 CP 自由基反应。鉴于两者均已在星周包层中探测到，作者指出 $c$-C$_3$HCP 是可在富磷环境搜寻的潜在星际分子。研究还考察 CP 与苯（C$_6$H$_6$）生成 CP-苯（C$_6$H$_5$CP）的反应：某些量子化学方法给出一个边缘出现且暂定的过渡态，而其他方法未能得到，因此 CP + PAH 反应生成 CP 取代苯环型 PAHs 在天体物理环境中**有可能，但目前不确定**。文章进一步给出 $c$-C$_3$HCP 的显式相关耦合簇四阶力场与二阶振动微扰理论振动频率和转动常数分析，并用密度泛函理论预测 CP-苯以及 CP-萘（C$_{10}$H$_7$CP）两种异构体的相应性质。结果表明，这些分子红外强度低且与 PAH 特征重叠，**红外观测搜寻可能不成功**；但其偶极矩较大，**射电天文探测更有可行性**。$c$-C$_3$HCP 的无势垒生成以及 C$_6$H$_5$CP 可能的无势垒合成，被视为研究其他 CP 取代芳香分子的范例，**可能开启天体芳香功能化的新方向**。
summary: Quantum chemical computations outline a thermodynamically viable, low-temperature, gas-phase formation pathway for phosphaethynyl cyclopropenylidene ($c$-C$_3$HCP), resulting from cyclopropenylidene ($c$-C$_3$H$_2$) and the phosphaethynyl (CP) radical. Given the detections of both $c$-C$_3$H$_2$ and the CP radical toward circumstellar shells along with the provided reaction pathway, $c$-C$_3$HCP is a potentially present astro-molecule which could be searched for in phosphorus rich environments. The reaction of CP and benzene (C$_6$H$_6$) to produce phosphaethynyl benzene (C$_6$H$_5$CP) is also explored. A marginally emerged, but tentative, transition state is identified for this reaction using certain quantum chemical approaches but not others. Consequently, the formation of CP-substituted benzoid polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in astrophysical environments from CP + PAH reactions is possible but currently uncertain. Additionally, explicitly correlated coupled cluster quartic force field and second-order vibrational perturbation theory rovibrational analysis of the vibrational frequencies and rotational constants of $c$-C$_3$HCP are provided, as well as density functional theory predictions of the same for CP-benzene (C$_6$H$_5$CP) and both isomers of CP-naphthalene (C$_1$$_0$H$_7$CP). Our results suggest that IR searches for these molecules would likely be unsuccessful due to the low intensities and coincidence with PAH features, but their large dipole moments could make them feasible to detect with radio astronomy. The barrierless formation of $c$-C$_3$HCP and possibly barrierless synthesis of C$_6$H$_5$CP stand as examples for future investigations of other CP-substituted aromatic molecules, marking the potential beginning of a new frontier of astronomical aromatic functionalization.

title: Optical and near-infrared s-process abundance scales in the Galactic disc
background_knowledge:
银河系盘中的重元素丰度，尤其是慢中子俘获过程（s-process）产物，是示踪恒星核合成与化学演化的重要探针。与快中子俘获 r-process 相比，s-process 主要发生在渐近巨星支（AGB）星等较低中子密度环境，通过中子俘获逐步合成 Ce、Nd 等元素；观测上常用相对太阳的丰度比 $[\mathrm{X/Fe}]$ 描述，其空间分布与径向梯度反映星际介质的富集历史和混合过程。
\n丰度测定依赖高分辨率光谱、恒星大气模型、连续谱归一化和谱线拟合。光学与近红外波段对有效温度、表面重力、金属丰度、分子带及连续谱位置的敏感性不同。近红外 H 波段在金属丰度较高时布满 CN、CO 等分子线，形成分子森林与线遮蔽（line blanketing），压低局部连续谱；这会改变谱线深度和拟合结果，若处理不当便造成丰度标尺的系统性偏差。
\n因此，不同巡天之间的丰度交叉定标是银河系化学演化研究的基础。Gaia-ESO Survey 提供光学高分辨率丰度基线，APOGEE/SDSS-V MWM 提供近红外大规模恒星参数与丰度；二者若存在标尺差异，可能伪造或抹平径向梯度，影响对银河系盘富集、径向迁移和恒星形成历史的推断。
contribution: 本文利用光学 Gaia-ESO Survey DR5 与近红外 SDSS-V/MWM DR19 的恒星直接交叉匹配，系统检验 s-process 丰度标尺差异。结果显示，大气参数与 Ce 丰度呈稳健的 $1:1$ 对应关系，而 Nd 丰度出现系统性的 X 形纵向拉伸：SDSS-V 流程相对稳定的光学基线把 Nd 的本征变化放大了约 5.54 倍。作者指出，这一放大源于 APOGEE H 波段的基线压缩：在高金属丰度下，CN 与 CO 分子森林的增长压低了局部连续谱，使近红外丰度测定中的 $\chi^2$ 最小化引擎为达到数学收敛而抬高导出丰度。**因此，近红外 Nd 丰度标尺的扩张是谱线遮蔽导致的谱学伪影，而非真实的银河系物理趋势。** 论文进一步给出经验定标框架以协调两类标尺；该改正可消除近期近红外巡天报告的负径向 $[\mathrm{Nd/Fe}]$ 梯度 $-0.052\ \mathrm{dex\,kpc^{-1}}$，并使其与光学高分辨率 Gaia-ESO Survey 所确立的上升趋势一致。
summary: A discrepancy has recently emerged between optical and near-infrared (NIR) s-process abundance scales, particularly for Neodymium (Nd). We investigated this issue using a direct cross-match between the optical Gaia-ESO Survey (DR5) and NIR SDSS-V/MWM (DR19). While atmospheric parameters and Cerium (Ce) abundances exhibit robust 1:1 correlations, Nd displays a systematic X-shaped vertical stretching. Our analysis reveals that the SDSS-V pipeline expands intrinsic Nd variations by a scaling factor of 5.54 relative to the stable optical baseline. This phenomenon is driven by baseline compression in the APOGEE H-band, where the growth of the molecular forest (CN and CO) at high metallicities depresses the local continuum. This forces the chi^2 minimisation engine in the NIR abundance determination to inflate derived abundances to reach mathematical convergence. We provide an empirical calibration framework to reconcile these disparate regimes. This correction effectively eliminates the contradictory negative radial [Nd/Fe] gradient of -0.052 dex/kpc reported in recent NIR surveys, bringing them into alignment with the rising trends established by the optical high-resolution Gaia-ESO survey. These results demonstrate that the observed scale expansion is a spectroscopic artefact of line-blanketing rather than a physical Galactic trend.

title: The LBT Y$_{\rm p}$ Project VI: Gas-Phase Chemical Abundance Patterns of Metal-Poor Nebulae
background_knowledge: 低金属度星云（如 H II 区、蓝致密矮星系中的电离气体）是研究恒星核合成、星际介质（ISM）化学演化与原初氦丰度的重要实验室。其光谱中的复合线、碰撞激发线与禁线携带电子温度、密度、电离态和元素丰度信息；研究范式是测量离子丰度，评估电离修正因子（ICF），并借助尘埃耗损、星族合成与化学演化模型将观测到的气相丰度解释为元素总丰度。不同元素的产生渠道不同：O、Ne、S、Ar、Cl、K 等主要与 $\alpha$ 元素或奇 $Z$ 核合成相关，Fe 主要由 Type Ia 超新星贡献并在冷星际气体中显著耗损到尘埃中；N 则可由初级与次级核合成产生，因此在低金属度下常出现 $\log(\mathrm{N/O})$ 平台。精确测量 $Y_{\rm p}$ 需要极低金属度、电离结构简单的星云，并要求同时可靠扣除金属线、尘埃与电离修正的影响；这些金属丰度本身也约束星系化学演化、恒星初始质量函数与电离源性质。
contribution: 本文利用 LBT $Y_{\rm p}$ Project 的静止光学与近红外联合观测，对 62 个低金属度星云给出气相 N、O、Ne、S、Cl、Ar、K 与 Fe 的丰度模式。作者逐一评估各元素的电离修正因子，并选取能重现观测离子丰度趋势的修正方案。结果显示：$\mathrm{Ne/O}$、$\mathrm{S/O}$ 与 $\mathrm{Ar/O}$ **不随金属度演化，且与太阳比值一致**；考虑 S 与 Ar 的 Type Ia 富集后，太阳的 $\mathrm{S/O}$ 与 $\mathrm{Ar/O}$ 暗示在固定 $\mathrm{O/H}$ 下，本地星系具有比高 $z$ 星系更延展的恒星形成历史。本文**首次报告低金属度河外星云中的 ISM K 丰度**，并发现 $\mathrm{Cl/O}$ 与 $\mathrm{K/O}$ 随 $\mathrm{O/H}$ 保持不变，说明这些奇 $Z$ 元素的产生跟随 $\alpha$ 元素。与以往分析一致，气相 $\mathrm{Fe/O}$ 随 $\mathrm{O/H}$ 升高而下降，归因于尘埃耗损；修正后平均 $[\mathrm{Fe/O}] = -0.80$，**暗示存在铁贫乏且能产生硬电离谱的恒星**。由 50 个星云得到的金属度不敏感 $\log(\mathrm{N/O})$ 平台为 $-1.43 \pm 0.10$，与先前工作一致；另有 5 个星系的 $\mathrm{N/O}$ 显著高于主平台，文中讨论了它们的性质、可能偏倚 $\mathrm{N/O}$ 测量的机制，以及能在低金属度产生增强 N 的核合成前身天体。
summary: Through a combined rest-optical and NIR observing campaign, the Large Binocular Telescope Primordial He Abundance ($Y_{\rm p}$) Project has delivered a precision measurement of $Y_{\rm p}$. Given the stringent requirements to measure gas-phase He abundances, the optical spectra contain emission features from a plethora of metals in the Interstellar Medium (ISM). We present gas-phase N, O, Ne, S, Cl, Ar, K and Fe abundance patterns in 62 low-metallicity nebulae. We assess ionization correction factors for each element and select those that reproduce the observed ionic abundance trends. The Ne/O, S/O, and Ar/O abundances do not evolve with metallicity and agree with the solar ratios. Given the Type Ia enrichment of S and Ar, the solar S/O and Ar/O suggest extended star formation histories in local galaxies relative to high-$z$ galaxies at fixed O/H. We report the first ISM K abundances in low-metallicity extragalactic nebulae; both Cl/O and K/O are constant with O/H, indicating the production of these odd-Z elements follows that of $α$ elements. Consistent with prior analyses, gas-phase Fe/O is observed to decrease with O/H due to dust depletion; correcting for this produces an average [Fe/O]$=$$-$0.80, implying Fe-deficient stars capable of producing hard ionizing spectra. Finally, the metallicity-insensitive log(N/O) plateau from 50 nebulae is $-$1.43$\pm$0.10, consistent with previous works. Five galaxies have N/O significantly enhanced relative to the primary plateau, and we discuss their properties, mechanisms that could bias measurements of N/O, and nucleosynthetic progenitors that can produce enhanced N at low metallicity.

title: AGB-star Mass Transfer Products in Stellar Streams as Tracers of Density in Dissolved Star Clusters
background_knowledge: 球状星团是银河系中恒星密度很高的引力束缚系统，其内部双星会频繁经历动力学交会：近距遭遇可使双星轨道硬化、交换伴星，甚至将双星瓦解。与之相对，恒星流是星团被潮汐瓦解后留下的长条状碎片，恒星密度低、动力学演化相对平静，因而可长期保留星团早期的星族与双星信息。AGB 质量转移是指一颗恒星从渐近巨星分支（AGB）伴星吸积物质，导致表面化学丰度改变，常表现为 s 过程元素增丰等特征；这类过程可发生在标准 Roche 瓣溢流（RLOF）中，也可通过 AGB 星风被伴星捕获的 wind Roche-lobe overflow（WRLOF）发生。研究星团中这类质量转移产物比例，有助于理解双星在致密环境中的存活与演化，并利用恒星流这一“化石”约束已被瓦解星团的初始性质。
contribution: 论文利用 CMC 程序及最新的、由观测驱动的双星设定，运行了一组初始密度不同的球状星团模拟，并借助内置的 COSMIC 双星演化代码，先找出若不受扰动便可能通过标准 Roche 瓣溢流或 wind Roche-lobe overflow 发生 AGB 质量转移的原初双星，再统计它们在星团动力学环境中存活足够久并真正经历 AGB 质量转移的比例。结果显示，**wind Roche-lobe overflow 对于重现银河系球状星团中约 $\sim 1\%$ 的、可能源于 AGB 质量转移的（亚）巨星比例是必要的**；同时，**双星动力学能够合理说明为何该比例在致密、完整的球状星团中低于恒星流**。作者进一步指出，未来对没有已知母星团的恒星流开展观测时，其中的质量转移产物、碰撞产物和双星丰度，将可用于探测已被瓦解星团的密度；这类密度信息难以直接测定，但对改进恒星流建模以及预测多种天体瞬变源的 rates 具有关键意义。
summary: The least dense globular clusters (GCs) appear to host the highest fractions of stars with chemical signatures of mass transfer from asymptotic giant branch (AGB) companions. Recent observations suggest the fraction may be even higher in stellar streams that are debris of tidally disrupted (preferentially low-density) GCs. We explore whether this is attributable to lower encounter rates in less-dense GCs allowing more of the relevant binaries to survive dynamical hardening, or outright disruption, long enough to undergo AGB mass transfer. We run a small suite of GC simulations varying initial density using the code CMC with its latest observationally motivated binary prescriptions. Using CMC's built-in COSMIC code for binary stellar evolution, we first identify primordial binaries that would, if left unperturbed, likely undergo AGB mass transfer via either standard or wind Roche-lobe overflow.
